fix_subject: Fix a bug caused by the recent JIT optimization : ignore destroyed blocks.
defect: GetBlockNumberFromEmuHackOp maps an emuhack op back to a block by searching normalEntry over all blocks, including destroyed (invalid) ones, so it can return a stale block.
The new GetBlockNumberFromEmuHackOp searches blocks by normalEntry without skipping destroyed (invalid) blocks, so an emuhack op can resolve to a dead block.

fix_subject: Fix sceAtracGetBufferInfoForReseting.
defect: sceAtracGetBufferInfoForReseting reports neededBytes = Sampleoffset - first.size without clamping it to first.writableBytes, so it can ask the game to write more data than the buffer allows.
The newly computed neededBytes written to the reset buffer info is not limited to writableBytes, so the game can be told it must write more bytes than the buffer accepts.

fix_subject: Fix wave on different dps
defect: The two added 'antialiasing' RectVGradient calls per 1-dp column double the vertices to 24 per step, which overflows the 65536-vertex DrawBuffer (assert) on wide dp resolutions such as 4K at 1:1.

The two added antialiasing rects double the wave's vertices to 24 per dp column without any cap, so a background wider than about 2730 dp overflows DrawBuffer's 65536-vertex buffer and hits its always-on assert.

fix_subject: Fix crash on shutdown in Qt.
defect: Replacing the explicit delete audio with QScopedPointers makes MainAudio and the running QThread get destroyed at the end of main, after NativeShutdown, so their destructors touch emulator internals that are already shut down and Qt crashes on exit.
Replacing the explicit delete of audio before NativeShutdown with QScopedPointers makes the audio object and the thread destruct after NativeShutdown and net::Shutdown, which crashes on exit.

fix_subject: Fix sceJpegGetOutputInfo
defect: sceJpegGetOutputInfo returns 0xC000 on a bad address or bad data, a positive value that games such as God Eater Burst read as a valid buffer size instead of an error.
The new sceJpegGetOutputInfo returns 0xC000 on a bad address or undecodable JPEG, which games such as God Eater Burst do not recognise as an error.

fix_subject: Use the CPU color conversion from GLES for readbacks in Vulkan (and D3D11). Fix bug.
defect: CopyReadbackBuffer steps the source row pointer by width bytes instead of width * pixelSize while copying width * pixelSize bytes per row, so Vulkan readbacks are garbled.
The new readback copy loop computes the source row as mappedData + width * y, omitting the 4-byte pixel size, so the rows it copies are wrong.

fix_subject: Fix bug in vulkan init. Add some sanity checks to GL shader cache loading.
defect: The new duplicate check compiles the vertex shader first and, when the id is already cached, neither inserts nor deletes it, leaking the compiled shader.
The new duplicate check compiles the vertex shader first and then, on a duplicate id, only logs and drops the compiled shader, leaking it.

fix_subject: Fix replacement funcs in the interpreter.
defect: Re-enabling the fabsf entry with a null replaceFunc makes the interpreter's Int_Emuhack call a null function pointer when fabsf is replaced.
Enabling the fabsf entry with a null C replaceFunc makes the interpreter's Int_Emuhack call a null function pointer whenever fabsf is replaced.

fix_subject: Fix replacement funcs in the interpreter.
defect: Int_Emuhack checks the emuhack subop against 1 although EMUOP_CALL_REPLACEMENT is 2, so every replacement call trips the debug assert.
Int_Emuhack checks the emuhack subop against 1 (EMUOP_RETKERNEL) instead of EMUOP_CALL_REPLACEMENT (2), so debug builds assert on every interpreted replacement call.

fix_subject: Also don't convert 16-bit bone weights to float. Fixes a bug from the last similar change.
defect: Switching weights to the 0..2 halved convention (16-bit /65535, floats *0.5, shader *2) left the software-transform ReadWeights reading 16-bit weights as plain floats, so software skinning gets half-size weights.

The commit halves 16-bit (and float) bone weights during decode (/65535) to match a new x2 in the vertex shader, but the software-transform path reads them through ReadWeights uncompensated, so its skinning uses half weights.

fix_subject: Fix joystick keys
defect: SimulateGamepad tests pad_buttons with bitwise OR instead of AND, so every condition is always true and the stick is always pushed.
SimulateGamepad tests pad_buttons with bitwise OR (|) instead of AND (&), so every condition is always true and the stick is always pushed.

fix_subject: fixes #4443 buffer underrun in the audio system
defect: On underrun __AudioMix clears the tail with memset(..., remains) where remains counts s16 samples, so only half of the missing samples are zeroed and stale data is played.
The new underrun padding passes remains (a count of s16 samples) to memset as a byte count, clearing only half of the tail.

fix_subject: Fix check for Android version in whether to display "ignore camera notch when centering" Fixes #13774
defect: The camera-inset option is shown only for SYSPROP_SYSTEMVERSION >= 29 although display-cutout insets exist from API 28, so Android 9 devices with notches never get the option.
The camera-notch option is shown only on Android API 29 and higher, although the Java side reports safe insets from API 28 (P), so Android 9 devices never see it.

fix_subject: Fix typo
defect: check_variables casts to the non-existent type IOTimingMethod (the enum is IOTimingMethods), so the libretro core does not compile.
The new option update casts to the nonexistent type IOTimingMethod* (the enum is IOTimingMethods), so the libretro core does not compile.

fix_subject: Fixed potential shutdown deadlock issue
defect: On shutdown the worker wakes with active false and still locks doneMutex, which the owning thread holds since construction, while the destructor waits in join(), so the two deadlock.
On shutdown the worker still locks doneMutex to notify completion, while the destroying thread holds doneMutex and waits in join, so destruction can deadlock.

fix_subject: riscv: Fix signed position bug in vertexjit.
defect: Jit_PosS16Through converts the signed X and Y positions with an unsigned FCVT (WU), so negative through-mode coordinates become huge values.
Jit_PosS16Through converts the signed X and Y positions with an unsigned conversion (FConv::WU), although the code's own comment says they are signed.

fix_subject: Fix code typo in NEON reinterpret cast.
defect: The new NEON path assigns vreinterpret_s8_u64 (an int8x8_t) to a uint8x8_t, a type mismatch that breaks compilation on strict NEON compilers (issue #19258).
The new NEON path assigns vreinterpret_s8_u64 (int8x8_t) to a uint8x8_t, a type mismatch that fails to compile on strict compilers.

fix_subject: Fix issue with misdetection of framebuffer copies.
defect: Splitting the single vfb loop into source and destination loops kept the 0x44000/0x88000 size-mismatch skip only in the destination loop, so the framebuffer at dst, previously skipped entirely, can now become a source candidate.

Splitting the single vfb loop into separate src and dst loops left the 0x44000/0x88000 video-size skip only in the dst loop, so such buffers became source candidates and copies were misdetected (Brothers in Arms).

fix_subject: Fix Local IP detection on non-Windows system
defect: On non-Windows getLocalIp now overwrites the socket-derived localip with gethostbyname(gethostname()), which on Linux/Android typically yields a loopback address, so the local IP is detected wrongly.
On non-Windows, getLocalIp now overwrites the correct localip (from getsockname) with gethostbyname(gethostname()), which on POSIX systems typically gives a loopback address.

fix_subject: Dialog: Avoid crash with hacked dialog start.
defect: ChangeStatusShutdown now always runs the threaded UtilityDialogShutdown on the accessThread, even when the dialog never started (status NONE, e.g. a savedata Init that fails), leaving a shutdown in flight that breaks a following dialog start.

ChangeStatusShutdown now always starts the access-thread shutdown, even for a dialog that never started (status NONE), and UtilityDialogShutdown asserts that no other access thread is still running, which crashes when a hacked dialog start overlaps another dialog's shutdown.

fix_subject: Fix typo
defect: The save task creates the directory from filename.NavigateUp() (the replacement source path) instead of saveFilename.NavigateUp(), so the target folder under the new-textures directory is not created.
SaveTextureTask creates the directory of filename (the replacement path under basePath_) instead of saveFilename (under newTextureDir_), so the save directory is not created.

fix_subject: Improve Atrac id generating and fix crash.
defect: createAtrac hands out IDs from a u8 counter that only increments, with no wrap limit or check against live IDs, so after 256 creations it reuses an ID still in atracMap, overwriting and leaking that context.
createAtrac takes IDs from a u8 counter that wraps without checking atracMap, so after 256 creations a new atrac can overwrite (and leak) one still in use.

fix_subject: Depth raster: Bugfix, minor opt (#19768)
defect: The NEON LoadConvertS8 calls vmovl_s16 on the int8x8_t value instead of the widened value16, which is a type error and the wrong conversion.
The NEON LoadConvertS8 passes the int8x8_t value to vmovl_s16 instead of the widened value16, which is wrong and does not compile.

fix_subject: Fix a possible race on shutdown.
defect: CPU_NextState and CPU_SetState change cpuThreadState and notify the condition variable without holding cpuThreadLock, so a waiter in CPU_WaitStatus can miss the wakeup (lost-wakeup race/deadlock on shutdown and run handshakes).

CPU_NextState and CPU_SetState change cpuThreadState and notify the condition variable without holding cpuThreadLock, so a waiter can check its predicate, miss the notify and sleep forever (lost wakeup, e.g. on shutdown).

fix_subject: Fix D3D9 crash (made a mistake with locking)
defect: LockRect is called with D3DLOCK_DISCARD for every mip level and also for D3DPOOL_MANAGED textures without D3DUSAGE_DYNAMIC, which is invalid, so the lock fails and rect.pBits is used uninitialized, crashing.

LockRect is called with D3DLOCK_DISCARD for every level, although the texture is D3DPOOL_MANAGED/usage 0 on non-Ex devices and DISCARD is only valid on dynamic textures and the top level, so the lock fails and the code writes through an invalid rect.

fix_subject: Fix recent texture scaling bug. Should help #9250
defect: The new Jit_TcU8ToFloat converts u8 texcoords with UCVTF but omits the 1/128 normalization that Step_TcU8ToFloat applies, producing texcoords 128x too large.
The new Jit_TcU8ToFloat converts the u8 texcoords with plain UCVTF and omits the 1/128 scale that Step_TcU8ToFloat applies, giving wrong UVs on ARM64.

fix_subject: Fix frameskip + unbuffered
defect: The new split of skipDrawReason returns on SKIPDRAW_SKIPFRAME before SetRenderFrameBuffer, so during frameskip the new unbuffered logic (display-FB tracking, dirtyAfterDisplay, SKIPDRAW_NON_DISPLAYED_FB) is not updated and frameskip with unbuffered rendering breaks.

The split skip check returns on SKIPDRAW_SKIPFRAME before SetRenderFrameBuffer, so with frameskip the new unbuffered logic (dirtyAfterDisplay, NON_DISPLAYED_FB tracking in SetRenderFrameBuffer) is not updated and frameskip breaks unbuffered rendering.

fix_subject: Fixed Path issue
defect: ToShortFriendlyPath calls path_.ToVisualString() on path_, which is a std::string, so non-UWP builds fail to compile.
ToShortFriendlyPath calls path_.ToVisualString() on a std::string member, which does not compile on non-UWP builds.

fix_subject: Fix minor bug in NewUI and make frameskipping strings translatable.
defect: The commit renamed ID_OPTIONS_FRAMESKIP_1/FRAMESKIP_1 to ID_OPTIONS_FRAMESKIP_AUTO/FRAMESKIP_AUTO in resource.h and WndMainWindow.h but left 'case ID_OPTIONS_FRAMESKIP_1: setFrameSkipping(FRAMESKIP_1);' in WndProc, so the Windows build no longer compiles (and it also translated a formatted message with g->T).

The commit renames ID_OPTIONS_FRAMESKIP_1/FRAMESKIP_1 to ..._AUTO in resource.h and WndMainWindow.h but leaves case ID_OPTIONS_FRAMESKIP_1: setFrameSkipping(FRAMESKIP_1) in the command handler, a Windows compile error.

fix_subject: Fix colortest rounding using vec3
defect: The color-test equality path emits round255f(v.rgb), but round255f takes a float, so the generated GLSL fails to compile for vec3.
The color test emits round255f(v.rgb), passing a vec3 to the float-only round255f, so the generated GLSL fails to compile when color test equality is used.

fix_subject: http: Oops, fix crash.
defect: Exists() dereferences cache_->HasData() although cache_ stays nullptr when the file size is 0 (InitCache is skipped), causing a null-pointer crash.
Exists() dereferences cache_ unconditionally, but the constructor leaves cache_ null when the file size is 0, so it crashes (e.g. for missing or unreachable http files).

fix_subject: Headless: Prevent crash running graphics tests.
defect: Centralizing vsync made the GPUCommon constructor call UpdateVsyncInterval(true), which compares the uninitialized new member lastVsync_ and calls gfxCtx_->SwapInterval even for GPUs without a context (headless), crashing.

Centralizing vsync makes the GPUCommon constructor call UpdateVsyncInterval(true), which calls gfxCtx_->SwapInterval even when headless runs with a null graphics context (crash), and adds lastVsync_ without an initializer.

fix_subject: Fix crash in Zip UI. Make another crash happen earlier.
defect: When the ZIP has no PSP content, progressBar_ and doneView_ are never created, but update() still dereferences progressBar_ when the GameManager state is not IDLE, causing a null-pointer crash.

progressBar_ (and doneView_) are now only created for ZIPs with PSP content, but update() still dereferences progressBar_ unguarded in the non-idle branch, crashing when the game manager is busy on a non-PSP ZIP screen.

fix_subject: Fix typo, should definitely be VX().
defect: Comp_Vmtvc maps the VFPU register with fpr.MapRegV(vs) but stores fpr.RX(vs), the FPU-register accessor, so the wrong host register is written to vfpuCtrl.
The new Comp_Vmtvc maps VFPU register vs with MapRegV but stores fpr.RX(vs), the FPU-register accessor, so the wrong host register is written to the VFPU control register.

fix_subject: Fix issue #2758 Tactics Ogre: Map flickering
defect: The added condition '|| entry->invalidHint == -1' re-attaches entries holding an invalid framebuffer on every exact match, making textures switch between framebuffers and causing map flickering in Tactics Ogre.
Allowing re-attachment when entry->invalidHint == -1 makes exact-match render-to-texture re-attach framebuffers to invalid entries repeatedly, causing map flickering in Tactics Ogre.

fix_subject: Fix parentheses placement in case SCE_UTILITY_SAVEDATA_TYPE_SINGLEDELETE.
defect: The SINGLEDELETE case writes 'if(param.Delete(param.GetPspParam()), param.GetSelectedSave())', so the comma operator discards Delete's result and the selected save is not passed to Delete.
The SINGLEDELETE case writes if(param.Delete(param.GetPspParam()), param.GetSelectedSave()), so Delete is called without the selected save and the comma operator makes the condition the save index.

fix_subject: Fix UV offsets in 16->32 reinterpret. Better, but something is still not quite right.
defect: The new 16-to-32-bit reinterpret shader samples the left texel at v_texcoord (the boundary between two source texels) and the right one at +0.5 texel, instead of at -0.25 and +0.25 of the destination pixel, so it reads the wrong 16-bit pixels.
The new 16-to-32-bit reinterpret samples the left pixel at v_texcoord and the right at +0.5/texSize.x instead of offsetting both by a quarter, so it reads the wrong source texels.

fix_subject: Oops it still random crashed destructor do the fix well
defect: ChatMenu is registered as a global pointer through setChatPointer (EmuScreen) and the friend-finder thread calls ch->UpdateChat(), but ChatMenu has no destructor clearing it, so after the popup closes proAdhoc uses a dangling pointer and crashes randomly.

The chat feature stores the ChatMenu pointer via setChatPointer when opening it but never clears it when the screen is destroyed, so proAdhoc's friend-finder thread calls ch->UpdateChat() on a freed screen and crashes.

fix_subject: Fix minor typo.
defect: The new context-switch DEBUG_LOG format string ends with '%08)', an invalid conversion specifier, so formatting is undefined (garbage output or an invalid-parameter abort in MSVC CRT) and the last argument is not printed.
The new context-switch log format ends with pc: %08) with no conversion character, an invalid printf specifier (undefined behaviour, garbled log).

fix_subject: Fix small issue with open dialog path, remove dupe hle func, add and reorder some
defect: BrowseAndBoot puts the memstick PSP/GAME directory into the file-name buffer instead of passing it as the dialog's initial folder (and without a trailing separator), so 'open from memstick' does not open the dialog in that folder.
BrowseAndBoot passes the default directory as the in/out filename fn instead of the initial-folder argument, and the memstick path lacks a trailing backslash, so the dialog does not open in PSP/GAME.

fix_subject: fixed stencil
defect: DxState3::set and restore pass p2 instead of p3 for the third render state, so stencil pass-op and stencil mask are set to the wrong values.
DxState3::set and restore pass p2 for the third render state instead of p3, so e.g. stencilOp's pass op and stencilFunc's mask get the wrong value.

fix_subject: Don't crash on missing readback formats.
defect: The moved Thin3DFormatToFormatAndType turns the former ELOG in the default case into _assert_msg_, so a readback with an unsupported format (for example S8 on GLES) crashes instead of returning false.
Thin3DFormatToFormatAndType asserts (PanicYesNo then Crash) on an unsupported format instead of only returning false, so a readback in a missing format crashes.

fix_subject: Fix button spacing in Settings/Menu UI
defect: The new GraphicsScreen shows a Frame Skipping checkbox bound to a local bool fs but never writes it back to g_Config.iFrameSkip, so the checkbox has no effect.
The new GraphicsScreen shows a Frame Skipping checkbox bound to a local bool fs but never writes it back to g_Config.iFrameSkip, so the setting cannot be changed there.

fix_subject: Fix two armjit bugs the testrunner found.
defect: The new clo implementation computes RSB(R0, rs, 0), the two's-complement negation, instead of the bitwise NOT before CLZ, so count-leading-ones is wrong.
The new clo implementation uses RSB(R0, rs, 0), the arithmetic negation, instead of a bitwise NOT before CLZ, so it counts leading ones wrongly.

fix_subject: Fix vertical positioning, eliminate double-&
defect: The new Android text drawer measures and renders strings without collapsing the '&&' escape to '&', so UI labels show doubled ampersands.
The new Android text drawer measures and renders strings without collapsing the UI's escaped '&&' to '&' (the Qt drawer does), so ampersands are displayed doubled.

fix_subject: Fix sky plane fix (broke in my last VR refactor)
defect: The new #if XR_USE_GRAPHICS_API_OPENGL guards exclude OpenGL ES builds, so the Quest/Android VR build compiles PreprocessStepVR as a no-op and the sky plane fix stops working.

The new guard compiles the GL sky-plane preprocessing only under XR_USE_GRAPHICS_API_OPENGL, so on OpenGL ES VR builds (Quest) PreprocessStepVR becomes an empty stub and the sky-plane fix stops working.

fix_subject: Fix crash on quit / pause not working.
defect: The new Core_RunLoop sets coreState = CORE_RUNNING after GL_SwapBuffers, overwriting a pause or quit state another thread set during the swap.

The new run loop swaps buffers first and then sets coreState back to CORE_RUNNING, overwriting a pause or quit request that arrived during the swap; on non-Windows it also resets NEXTFRAME, so the loop never returns.

fix_subject: Fix some unicode bugs (open file dialog)
defect: The UNICODE port stores ConvertUTF8ToWString(...).c_str() of temporaries in OPENFILENAME (dangling pointers, filters truncated at the first embedded NUL) and casts the UTF-8 _strFileName buffer to wchar_t*.

The file-dialog code stores c_str() of temporary wstrings from ConvertUTF8ToWString in OPENFILENAME (dangling pointers, and the NUL-separated filter is cut at its first NUL), and casts a std::string buffer to wchar_t*.

fix_subject: Fix memory management for allocated block on Symbian. TODO: Use RChunks to make it more efficient.
defect: On Symbian AllocateMemoryPages calls mmap with fd -1 and MAP_PRIVATE but without MAP_ANON, which is not an anonymous mapping and fails, so allocation breaks.
On Symbian AllocateMemoryPages now calls mmap with fd -1 but without MAP_ANON, which fails (MAP_FAILED, not NULL), so the allocation is broken.

fix_subject: Fix crash when toggling Skip buffer effects while paused
defect: Moving the backbuffer bind into an else branch leaves no render target bound when CopyDisplayToOutput presents nothing (for example after toggling Skip buffer effects while paused), so the following darken/UI draw crashes.

When the emulator is not on top, the backbuffer is bound only in the else branch, assuming CopyDisplayToOutput always binds it; when nothing is presented no render target is bound and the following UI draw crashes.

fix_subject: Fix a possible infinite loop in the symbol map.
defect: The new GetSymbolInfo returns the unique entry found by start address without checking that it extends past the queried address, so with duplicates it can return a symbol that does not contain it and callers advancing by its size loop forever.

The new GetSymbolInfo fast path returns the unique entry at start_address without checking that it actually covers address, so a duplicate start with a smaller size gives a range that excludes address and callers can loop forever.

fix_subject: Fixes (stage 2)
defect: Changing the AutoRun default to false makes every game start paused (startBreak = !bAutoRun) on all platforms, just to make the Qt 'Break on load' checkbox look right.
The AutoRun default was changed from true to false, so with default settings games start in break mode (startBreak = !bAutoRun) instead of running.

fix_subject: Remove wrong reserve call. Fixes new crash reported in #15932
defect: myVector.reserve(entry->children.size() - 2) underflows size_t when a directory has fewer than two children, so reserve throws or crashes.
reserve(entry->children.size() - 2) underflows size_t when a directory has fewer than two children, requesting a huge allocation that crashes.

fix_subject: Fix another rounding bug. ARM64 passes the fpu test again.
defect: The new applyRoundingMode stub branches past the js.currentRoundingFunc update when it skips the FPCR change, and currentRoundingFunc is never initialised, so float-to-int conversions can use a stale rounding function.
In the new applyRoundingMode, the skip for the default mode also jumps over the update of js.currentRoundingFunc, so after returning to the default mode the stale conversion function stays selected.

fix_subject: SDL: Skip FcFini() call, causes crashes.
defect: The new fontconfig fallback code calls FcFini() in the TextDrawerSDL destructor, which crashes on shutdown.
The new TextDrawerSDL destructor calls FcFini(), which is known to crash when fontconfig objects are still referenced (e.g. when the text drawer is recreated).

fix_subject: Fix another replacer lifecycle issue, causing unnecessary texture invalidation.
defect: With FindReplacement now returning nullptr when there is no replacement, 'if (replaced && replaced->IsInvalid()) ... else { match = false; }' sends the null case to the else branch and needlessly invalidates the texture (and plan.replaced->Valid() can dereference null).

With FindReplacement now returning nullptr when there is no replacement, the check replaced && replaced->IsInvalid() sends the null case to the else branch, which sets match = false and forces a texture reload every time.

fix_subject: Fix another way the scissor test could accidentally get disabled
defect: The scissored-clear change no longer re-enables GL_SCISSOR_TEST after a clear and explicitly disables it after a scissored clear, so later draws run without scissoring.
The scissored-clear support disables GL_SCISSOR_TEST after a scissored clear and no longer re-enables it after an unscissored one, so the scissor test is left off after clears.

fix_subject: Fix bugs and Clean up.
defect: The new sceHeapGetTotalFreeSize dereferences heapList[heapAddr] without a null check, and heapList is never cleared or given a serialisable Heap DoState.

The new sceHeap implementation dereferences heapList[heapAddr] without a null check in sceHeapGetTotalFreeSize, permanently changes the allocator grain via Setgrain_, returns 0 instead of an error for bad heaps and never clears heapList on init.

fix_subject: Fix Vulkan regression of #16075 due to silly typo.
defect: In EndCurRenderStep the input-attachment branch picks RP_TYPE_COLOR_INPUT when depth/stencil is used and RP_TYPE_COLOR_DEPTH_INPUT when it is not; the ternary arms are swapped.
The input-attachment case picks RP_TYPE_COLOR_INPUT when depth/stencil is used and RP_TYPE_COLOR_DEPTH_INPUT when it is not, the reverse of what is needed.

fix_subject: Fix ZipAssetReader file listing. Fixes post shaders on Android
defect: The change strips the leading dot from the extension (ext.substr(1)) while the filter set is built with a leading dot ('.' + tmp), so no file matches and ZIP asset listings (post shaders on Android) come back empty.

The added ext.substr(1) strips the dot from the extension while the filter set is built with a leading dot, so no file matches and filtered zip listings come back empty (post shaders missing on Android).

fix_subject: Fix a bad == comparison typo.
defect: sceKernelRegisterSubIntrHandler uses the assignment 'error = SCE_KERNEL_ERROR_FOUND_HANDLER' as an else-if condition (overwriting the returned error and always taking that branch), and the new release error log has a %08x without an argument.

sceKernelRegisterSubIntrHandler uses else if (error = SCE_KERNEL_ERROR_FOUND_HANDLER), an assignment that overwrites any other error with FOUND_HANDLER, and the release error log lacks its error argument.

fix_subject: Fix InvalidateICache() breaking binary searching.
defect: The new binary_search lookup in GetBlockNumberFromEmuHackOp drops the !invalid check of the old linear scan and relies on normalEntry being sorted, which DestroyBlock breaks by zeroing normalEntry, so destroyed blocks are returned or live blocks missed.

The binary search that replaces the linear scan drops the !invalid check and assumes normalEntry is sorted, but DestroyBlock zeroes normalEntry of invalidated blocks, so lookups fail or return invalid blocks.

fix_subject: Fix typo breaking old savestates.
defect: Bumping p.Section('FileNode', 1) to p.Section('FileNode', 2) makes version 2 the minimum, so savestates with FileNode version 1 fail to load despite the new 's >= 2' compatibility branch.
FileNode::DoState now calls p.Section("FileNode", 2), so the minimum version is 2 and savestates with FileNode version 1 no longer load, although the code has an s >= 2 compatibility branch.

fix_subject: Fix silly light direction math bug (probably no effect mostly).
defect: The directional-light prenormalization sets len = 1/len and then divides the components by len, multiplying them by the length instead of normalizing.
The directional-light prenormalization computes len = 1/length and then divides by it, multiplying the vector by its length instead of normalizing it.

fix_subject: Fix framebuf blit on resize.
defect: ResizeFramebufFBO takes the snapshot 'VirtualFramebuffer old = *vfb' only after bufferWidth/Height and renderWidth/Height were updated, so the blit from the old FBO uses the new dimensions.
ResizeFramebufFBO copies VirtualFramebuffer old = *vfb only after updating bufferWidth/renderWidth, so the blit from the old FBO uses the new dimensions.

fix_subject: Fix bug in D3D11 framebuffer readbacks, helps #9361, though seems off by half a pixel?
defect: PackFramebufferD3D11_ computes srcByteOffset but passes map.pData without it to ConvertFromRGBA8888, so readbacks with nonzero x/y read from the top-left of the staging texture.
PackFramebufferD3D11_ computes srcByteOffset but never applies it, so readbacks of a sub-rectangle copy from the top-left of the staging texture.

defect: SignalSema, WaitSema and WaitSemaCB are registered with WrapI_* wrappers that write v0 after the function returns, by which time the call may have switched threads, so the result lands in another thread's registers.
Wrapping the wait/signal semaphore functions in WrapI_ writes their return value to $v0 after they have already switched threads, so the result lands in the wrong thread's register.

fix_subject: Fix Grand Theft Auto - Vice City Stories
defect: The warm-up added to sceMpegAvcDecode and sceMpegAtracDecode makes the first decode calls return ERROR_MPEG_NO_DATA, which breaks Grand Theft Auto - Vice City Stories.
The added warm-up returns ERROR_MPEG_NO_DATA from sceMpegAvcDecode and sceMpegAtracDecode, which breaks video playback in Grand Theft Auto - Vice City Stories.

fix_subject: Fix logic
defect: Update now sets status = SCE_UTILITY_STATUS_FINISHED whenever status is not RUNNING, so with the preceding FINISHED-to-SHUTDOWN switch the dialog flips between SHUTDOWN and FINISHED and other states such as INITIALIZE are clobbered.
Update() now sets status = FINISHED whenever status is not RUNNING, so INITIALIZE and SHUTDOWN states are forced back to FINISHED and the dialog state machine never completes properly.

fix_subject: Fix reads from cache outside the file.
defect: ReadAt loops 'while (readSize < bytes)' over SaveIntoCache/ReadFromCache, but at or past end of file ReadFromCache returns 0, so reads beyond the file loop forever.
ReadAt loops while readSize < bytes without clamping to the file size or checking progress, so a read past end of file never makes progress and loops forever.

fix_subject: Bugfix in png_load.cpp
defect: stbi_load is asked for 4 components, but the copy allocates and copies x*y*n bytes where n is the file's original component count, so RGB images get a too-small buffer that callers read as RGBA.
The stb_image path allocates and copies x*y*n bytes, where n is the file's original component count, though stbi_load was asked for 4 components, so RGB images give a buffer that is too small.

fix_subject: Fix ThreadFrame. All OK now except shutdown, it seems
defect: ThreadFrame now returns didAnything, false whenever the render queue is momentarily empty, but callers (SDL, headless hosts, Android) treat false as a request to leave their render loop.
ThreadFrame now returns false whenever the render queue is momentarily empty, but callers such as SDLMain's main loop treat false as a request to exit and break out.

fix_subject: Fix buzzsaw noises in reverb by preventing integer wraparound in a couple of places
defect: ApplyWaveformEffect assigns the 32-bit send buffer accumulators directly into the s16 downsampled buffer, so values outside 16 bits wrap around and produce buzzing.
ApplyWaveformEffect stores 32-bit send-buffer samples into the s16 downsample buffer without clamping, so loud samples wrap around and the reverb sounds like a buzzsaw.

fix_subject: Fix check for glBlitFramebufferNV
defect: The condition now accepts GLES3 || NV_framebuffer_blit, but builds with MAY_HAVE_GLES3 still always call glBlitFramebuffer (absent on NV-only devices), and the #else branch calls glBlitFramebufferNV on builds where it may not exist.

The condition now accepts NV_framebuffer_blit, but in MAY_HAVE_GLES3 builds it still calls the GLES3 glBlitFramebuffer on non-GLES3 devices, and the #else branch calls glBlitFramebufferNV on platforms without it.

fix_subject: Fix stepping
defect: DisassemblyFunction::getLineNum with findStart assumes every line is 4 bytes, so an address inside a two-opcode macro line is not found and 0 is returned, breaking stepping.

DisassemblyFunction::getLineNum with findStart only matches an address within 4 bytes of a line start, so an address inside a two-opcode macro line (li or lui+load/store, 8 bytes) falls through and returns line 0, which breaks stepping.

fix_subject: Fix incorrect GPU timing with signal jumps.
defect: The new signal jump, call and return handlers change currentList->pc without calling UpdateCycles, unlike the regular JUMP/CALL/RET handlers, so GPU cycle accounting is wrong after a signal jump.

The new signal JUMP/CALL/RET handlers move currentList->pc without calling UpdateCycles, so cycleLastPC keeps the old pc and the next cycle count is taken across the jump (wrong, possibly huge GPU cycle totals).

fix_subject: D3D11: Fix shader module leak in thin3d.
defect: CreateGraphicsPipeline now AddRefs every shader module and stores it in shaderModules, but ~D3D11Pipeline never releases them, leaking shader modules.
CreateGraphicsPipeline now AddRefs every shader module and keeps them in shaderModules, but ~D3D11Pipeline never releases them, leaking the modules and their D3D11 shaders.

fix_subject: Fix a couple of bugs in vtxdec
defect: The new fast paths in Jit_WeightsU16 read the third weight from weightoff instead of weightoff + 4 and, for 1 and 2 weights, leave the padding weights unzeroed that the generic loop zeroes.

The new Jit_WeightsU16 fast paths are wrong: case 3 reads the third weight from weightoff instead of weightoff+4, and cases 1 and 2 write only 4 bytes, leaving the second weight dword uninitialised where the old loop zero-padded it.

fix_subject: softgpu: Fix some lighting bugs. Ambient and diffuse light should be working perfectly now.
defect: The new specular term adds att*spot*lsc*msc*pow(specular_factor, k) even when specular_factor is negative (surface facing away), producing negative or NaN specular contributions.
The new specular term adds att*spot*lsc*msc*pow(dot(H,N),k) without checking that the dot product is positive, so light from behind gives negative or NaN specular contributions.

fix_subject: Fix key map screen forgeting last pressed key
defect: KeyMappingNewKeyDialog::update overwrites last_kb_key with input.key_queue[0] every frame, so it is reset to 0 on frames without a key press and the dialog forgets the last pressed key.
KeyMappingNewKeyDialog::update overwrites last_kb_key with key_queue[0] on every frame, so it drops back to 0 as soon as no key is pressed and the dialog forgets the last pressed key.

fix_subject: Fix incorrect translation of Atrac3+ sound, and some accelerator key strings.
defect: The change moves the 'Rendering Backend' submenu translation to MENU_EMULATION but keeps SUBMENU_RENDERING_BACKEND = 7, which in the Emulation menu is the 'Enable Atrac3+' item, so that item is renamed to 'Rendering Backend' (Ctrl+1).

Moving the Rendering Backend submenu translation to MENU_EMULATION with the stale SUBMENU_RENDERING_BACKEND = 7 makes it overwrite Emulation menu item 7, the Enable Atrac3+ entry, with the Rendering Backend text (the submenu is item 11).

fix_subject: Fix nonsmooth sound issue and incomplete frame at the end of source and pcm buffers. using a std::string to save the source buffer, and changing the loading strategy so as we will not get any incomplete frame.
defect: The new AuCtx decode/stream logic decodes from AuBuf at writePos and, on a trailing incomplete frame, returns no PCM, rewinds readPos and only reloads when AuBufAvailable reaches 0, which leaves gaps (nonsmooth sound) at every buffer boundary.

The new AuCtx decoder decodes in place from AuBuf, so a frame cut off at the end of the buffer gives a zero-output decode (a silent gap) and is re-read by rewinding readPos, which produces non-smooth sound and incomplete frames.

fix_subject: Fix logging bug
defect: While moving the lock inside 'if (g_Config.bEnableSound)', the change reattached the 'Audio outbuffer overrun' log to the sound-disabled else branch, so it fires (unlocked) on every update with sound off and never on a real overrun.

Moving the lock inside the bEnableSound branch also moved the 'Audio outbuffer overrun' log into the sound-disabled else branch, so it fires on every update with sound off (reading outAudioQueue without the lock) and never on a real overrun.

fix_subject: Math3D: Something wrong with hand simd optimization in vec2<float>, so it causes very slow down. However, compiler optimization is faster enough, so removed it.
defect: The new SSE specializations of Vec2<float> operators run _mm_add_ps/_mm_mul_ps on the whole __m128, whose two upper lanes are never initialised for a Vec2, so garbage (possibly denormal) values cause severe slowdowns.

The new Vec2<float> SSE operator specialisations run 4-lane __m128 operations on a two-float vector whose upper lanes are never initialised, reading indeterminate data and making Vec2 arithmetic very slow.

fix_subject: Fix the prim counting to act as before
defect: The rewritten NotifyCommand increments primsThisFrame_ only for processed prims at the bail label, so prims skipped by restrictPrimRanges are no longer counted and prim numbering and range restriction go wrong.

primsThisFrame_ is now incremented only when process is true, so with a restricted prim range the counter stops at the first skipped prim, every later prim is skipped as well, and prim counting breaks.

fix_subject: Vulkan: Fix bug where shader blend texture overwrote normal texture binding. Fixes #10135
defect: The new secondary-texture block in GetOrCreateDescriptorSet reuses the single VkDescriptorImageInfo 'tex', overwriting the main texture's image and sampler so both descriptor writes bind the shader-blend texture.

The new secondary-texture descriptor write reuses the same VkDescriptorImageInfo tex as the main texture, so both writes point to the secondary view and sampler and the shader-blend texture overwrites the normal texture binding.

fix_subject: Fix bugs with fog bit in shader IDs
defect: The change enables the fog bit at bit 9 of the fragment shader ID, overlapping the 3-bit alpha test function stored at bits 9-11, so shaders with and without fog can collide on one ID.
The fog bit is put at bit 9 of the fragment shader ID, overlapping the 3-bit alpha test function in bits 9-11, so shaders that differ in fog (now emitted by this change) can share an ID.

fix_subject: Oops, changed the wrong function.
defect: The change added the 1/32768 fixed-point scaling (UCVTF fbits 15) to Jit_TcU16Prescale instead of Jit_TcU16ToFloat, wrongly rescaling prescaled U16 texcoords and leaving the ToFloat path unscaled.
The fixed-point UCVTF scale 15 was added to Jit_TcU16Prescale, which already multiplies by uvScale, instead of Jit_TcU16ToFloat, breaking prescaled U16 texture coordinates.

fix_subject: [Libretro] Crash fix
defect: The change passes log_cb (a function pointer) as userdata, but RetroLogCallback casts userdata to a pointer to a function pointer and dereferences it, calling through garbage and crashing on the first log.
RetroLogCallback receives the function pointer log_cb as userdata but casts it to retro_log_printf_t* and dereferences it, calling through garbage and crashing.

fix_subject: Fix
defect: The new snap code subtracts (touch - current center) modulo the grid size, so it only moves the control in grid-size steps relative to its current position and never aligns it to a fixed grid.
The grid snap subtracts (touch - current centre) % grid, so a control only moves in grid steps relative to where it already is and never aligns to an actual grid.

fix_subject: Fix
defect: The change passes achievement->title, a std::string, to a %s variadic log call, which is undefined behaviour (and rejected by clang).
AchievementDisabled passes achievement->title, a std::string, to the %s of INFO_LOG's varargs, which is undefined behaviour.

fix_subject: Fix a shutdown crash with close fonts.
defect: The change makes Close() set fontLibID_ to (u32)-1 while GetFontLib() indexes fontLibList[fontLibID_] unconditionally, so calling it on a closed font, as __FontShutdown does, reads out of bounds.

LoadedFont::GetFontLib now indexes fontLibList[fontLibID_] unconditionally while Close() sets fontLibID_ to (u32)-1, so __FontShutdown calling GetFontLib on a closed font reads out of bounds and crashes.

fix_subject: ARMJit: Fix bug in instruction mtv, affecting SSX
defect: In the new mtvc VFPU_CTRL_CC path the change emits MOV(gpr.R(MIPS_REG_VFPUCC), rt), using the MIPS register number as an ARM register instead of gpr.R(rt).
For mtvc into VFPU_CTRL_CC the new code emits MOV(gpr.R(MIPS_REG_VFPUCC), rt), passing the MIPS register number as an ARM register instead of gpr.R(rt), so the wrong host register is copied into CC.

fix_subject: Fix the skip buffer effects menu item not having immediate effect (wrong invalidation).
defect: The change switched the Skip Buffer Effects menu item from gpu_resized to gpu_configChanged, which does not trigger NotifyRenderResized/UpdateRenderSize where bSkipBufferEffects is applied, so the toggle had no immediate effect.

The Skip Buffer Effects menu item now sends gpu_configChanged instead of gpu_resized, and the config-changed path no longer notifies the framebuffer manager of a render resize, so toggling it has no immediate effect.

fix_subject: Fix retval and surrog pairs in sceCccEncodeUTF16().
defect: The new sceCccEncodeUTF16 returns a pointer that the firmware does not return and encodes out-of-range or surrogate code points instead of substituting the error character.
The new sceCccEncodeUTF16 encodes any u32 without rejecting code points above 0x10FFFF or in the surrogate range, and returns the advanced pointer where the real function returns nothing.

fix_subject: Fix wrong timer reading in MIPSDebugInterface, thanks Nemoumbra
defect: The new ticks branch in getReferenceValue tests REF_INDEX_USEC a second time instead of REF_INDEX_TICKS, so the ticks reference falls through and returns -1.
getReferenceValue tests REF_INDEX_USEC twice, so the new ticks reference never returns CoreTiming::GetTicks() and falls through to -1.

fix_subject: ReplacedTexture: Bugfix D3D workaround log check
defect: The new warning condition 'bc && (w & 3) != 0 || (h & 3) != 0' lacks parentheses, so it also fires for non-block-compressed textures whose height is not a multiple of 4.
The added test bc && (w & 3) != 0 || (h & 3) != 0 parses as (bc && w-test) || h-test, so the D3D11 block-size warning also fires for non-block-compressed textures whose height is not a multiple of 4.

fix_subject: Fix ridiculously bad typo.
defect: The new ordering guard swaps when endAddr > startAddr, reversing correctly ordered ranges so lower_bound(start) lies past upper_bound(end) and the loop and erase run over an invalid range (hang).

The guard swaps the bounds when endAddr > startAddr, i.e. exactly when they are already ordered, so lower_bound(start) lies past upper_bound(end) and the loop and erase run over an invalid range (hang or undefined behaviour).

fix_subject: ARM64 store optimization bugfix
defect: The change uses WZR whenever rt is a known-zero immediate, including for loads, so a load into such an rt targets WZR, discards the loaded value and leaves rt with the stale immediate.
The new WZR shortcut is also taken for loads whenever rt currently holds the immediate 0, so the loaded value goes to WZR and rt keeps the stale 0.

fix_subject: Fix toggle
defect: The change dropped toggle_(toggle) from the ComboKey constructor initializer list, leaving toggle_ uninitialized.
The rewritten ComboKey constructor drops the toggle_(toggle) initialiser, leaving toggle_ uninitialised so combo keys toggle or not at random.

fix_subject: Fix Mem Leak and other small fixes.
defect: CreateCodeList allocates enableCheat with new bool[] on every call (including the newly added call in OnBack) and never frees it, leaking memory.
CreateCodeList now allocates enableCheat with new bool[] on every call (from CreateViews and the new call in OnBack) and never frees it, leaking the array.

fix_subject: Fix vertex shader range culling - the bug check was wrong.
defect: canDiscardVertex is true when the BROKEN_NAN_IN_CONDITIONAL bug is present instead of when it is absent, inverting the previous !Has(...) check.
canDiscardVertex is set to GetBugs().Has(BROKEN_NAN_IN_CONDITIONAL) without the negation of the old code, so vertex range culling is enabled on exactly the drivers with the NaN bug.

fix_subject: Fix SW spotlight
defect: angle = toLight.Normalize() * lightDir.Normalize() multiplies the two lengths returned by Normalize() instead of taking the dot product of the normalized vectors, so the spotlight cone test is wrong.

The spotlight angle is computed as toLight.Normalize() * lightDir.Normalize(), but Normalize() returns the previous length, so angle is a product of lengths instead of a cosine and spotlights are wrong.

fix_subject: Fix wsbw
defect: wsbw (0xE0) emits IROp::BSwap16 instead of BSwap32, a copy-paste of the wsbh case.
The new IR Comp_Allegrex2 emits BSwap16 for wsbw, so word byte swaps are compiled as halfword swaps (the immediate path correctly uses swap32).

fix_subject: Fix Cwcheat code type for address compare
defect: The 0xD address-compare code computes addr2 with GetAddress(arg & 0xFFFFFFFF), keeping the code-type nibble (4-7) in the address instead of masking with 0x0FFFFFFF.
In the new 0xD address-compare code addr2 is GetAddress(arg & 0xFFFFFFFF), keeping the 4-7 type nibble in the address, so the address is invalid and the compare never runs.

fix_subject: Fix some NaN handling in a few funcs.
defect: Int_Vsocp clamps with std::min/std::max, which turn a NaN input into 0 instead of preserving NaN as the PSP VFPU does.
The new Int_Vsocp clamps with std::min/std::max, which turn a NaN input into 0 or 1 instead of propagating NaN as the PSP does.

fix_subject: Fix ridiculous bug that would ignore (and thus delete when resaved) the last line of ini files if it didn't end with a line break.
defect: IniFile::Load breaks on in.eof() before processing the line just read, so a last line without a trailing newline is ignored and deleted on resave.
IniFile::Load breaks out of the loop when in.eof() is set after getline, so a last line without a trailing newline is dropped and then deleted on the next save.

fix_subject: Fix bug with unthrottle as virtual key. Add button to restore default key mappings.
defect: onVKeyDown/onVKeyUp are called with key.keyCode instead of the virtual key code result, so the VIRTKEY_UNTHROTTLE switch never matches.

EmuScreen::key passes the raw key.keyCode to onVKeyDown/onVKeyUp, which switch on virtual key ids such as VIRTKEY_UNTHROTTLE, so the unthrottle virtual key never works (the old unthrottle handling was removed in the same change).

fix_subject: Fix savestate ruining the host audio update.
defect: __AudioDoState re-registers the AudioUpdateHost event with hleAudioUpdate instead of hleHostAudioUpdate, breaking host audio updates after a savestate load.
__AudioDoState re-registers the host audio event with hleAudioUpdate instead of hleHostAudioUpdate, so after loading a savestate the host audio update runs the wrong callback.

fix_subject: Fix wrong dump length.
defect: The decrypted EBOOT dump writes head->elf_size bytes instead of the decrypted length returned by pspDecryptPRX.
The decrypted EBOOT dump writes head->elf_size bytes instead of the decrypted length returned by pspDecryptPRX, so the dumped file has the wrong length.

fix_subject: Fix iOS / debug ARM build.
defect: The new _assert_ calls use JitState::PREFIX_KNOWN in the ARM JIT, which has ArmJitState, so debug/iOS ARM builds fail to compile.
The new GetVectorRegsPrefixD and ApplyPrefixD assert on JitState::PREFIX_KNOWN, a name the ARM JIT does not have (it uses ArmJitState), so debug and iOS ARM builds fail to compile.

fix_subject: Fix some pointer silliness that clang fortunately caught
defect: KernelLoadExecParam reads the PSP struct, whose argp/key fields are host pointers, with ReadStruct and casts them to u32, which truncates pointers and mis-sizes the struct on 64-bit (clang error).

KernelLoadExecParam reads the PSP struct into SceKernelLoadExecParam with host pointer fields, casts them with (u32)param.argp and stores new[] buffers back into them, which breaks on 64-bit hosts (struct layout, pointer truncation) and is rejected by clang.

fix_subject: Fix some pointer silliness that clang fortunately caught
defect: The added sprintf passes controllerMaps.size() (size_t) to a %i conversion, undefined behaviour on 64-bit.
The new sprintf passes controllerMaps.size() (a size_t) to a %i conversion, undefined behaviour on 64-bit hosts.

fix_subject: Fix silly mistake in vfpu_sincos. Add unittest.
defect: vfpu_sin/vfpu_cos/vfpu_sincos reduce the angle with floorf(angle*4)*0.25 instead of floorf(angle*0.25)*4, giving wrong results for most inputs.
vfpu_sin, vfpu_cos and vfpu_sincos reduce the angle with angle -= floorf(angle*4)*0.25f, i.e. modulo 0.25 instead of modulo the period 4, so the results are wrong for almost all inputs.

fix_subject: Fix customization of Leaderboard Submitted events.
defect: ShowLeaderboardSubmitted shows the message as MESSAGE_SUCCESS instead of the LEADERBOARD_SUBMITTED type this change introduced, so type-based handling (ClearAchievementStuff, later per-type customization) misses it.

The new ShowLeaderboardSubmitted shows its message as OSDType::MESSAGE_SUCCESS instead of the LEADERBOARD_SUBMITTED type this change added, so leaderboard-submitted popups are not treated as leaderboard events (not cleared by ClearAchievementStuff, later not placed per the notification-position setting).

fix_subject: Fix memory error in control mapping dialog
defect: A static const array stores pointers to this instance's categoryToggles_, initialized only once, so later ControlMappingScreen instances use dangling pointers.
A function-local static const array stores pointers to categoryToggles_ of the first ControlMappingScreen instance, so later screens use dangling pointers into a destroyed object (use-after-free).

fix_subject: Oops, left this wrong while debugging.
defect: In the texture preview, the VAO/buffer rebinding with an offset-0 attribute pointer sits in the indexed branch, so it runs even without VAO support and is skipped for non-indexed VAO draws.

In the indexed texture-preview path the change unconditionally binds texPreviewVao, ibuf and vbuf and sets the attribute pointer to offset 0 even when VAOs are unsupported (all three are 0), so the non-VAO path reads vertices through a null pointer.

fix_subject: Fix a bug that mouse cannot work correctly when maximize the window from 1x window size.
defect: The re-added 2x mouse coordinate factor still applies when the window is maximized from 1x size, since only bFullScreen and iWindowWidth are checked.

The re-added mouse coordinate factor of 2 is applied whenever iWindowWidth < 560 and not fullscreen, including when the window is maximized from 1x size, so mouse and touch coordinates are doubled and wrong.

fix_subject: Fix memview build
defect: The new header, added to the CMake, MSVC and Android builds while the code did not build, declares redraw(), which is never defined but is called from ImMemView.cpp.

The new ImMemView header and source, added to the CMake and VS builds, do not compile or link: for example redraw() is declared and called but never defined and the .cpp still uses Win32 member signatures.

fix_subject: Fix for Qt/Symbian.
defect: The new '#ifdef __GLIBC__' guards in sceRtcConvertLocalTimeToUTC and sceRtcConvertUtcToLocalTime send Symbian, which previously used tm_gmtoff, to the '-timezone' branch that does not work there.

The new #ifdef __GLIBC__ guard sends every non-glibc platform, including Qt/Symbian, to the #else branch that uses the global timezone variable, which does not work there, breaking the Symbian build of the local/UTC tick conversions.

fix_subject: Bugfixes
defect: The change stores the extension strings in std::string members of gl_extensions, a struct that CheckGLExtensions memsets to zero, and assigns possibly-null glGetString/wglGetExtensionsStringEXT/eglQueryString results to them.

The change stores the GL/WGL/EGL extension strings into std::string members of GLExtensions, which CheckGLExtensions memsets to zero (undefined behaviour on std::string), and assigning a null char pointer to them crashes.

fix_subject: Fix width/height inversion
defect: UpdateRenderResolution sets renderWidth=480*zoom and renderHeight=272*zoom in portrait and 272/480 in landscape, i.e. the two branches are swapped.
In UpdateRenderResolution the new portrait and landscape branches are swapped: portrait gets a 480x272 render size and landscape 272x480.

fix_subject: Fix savestates from before 1.4.2-420. Fixes #9998. Unfortunately this also breaks states between 420 and 468, so please save normally before upgrading if you were using one of those.
defect: The change inserts __UsbGpsDoState in the middle of the 'HLE Modules' savestate section, so states saved before it no longer load.
__UsbGpsDoState is inserted in the middle of the HLE Modules savestate section with a section whose minimum version is 1, so savestates made before this change fail to load.

fix_subject: Fix black screen when backing out of InstallZipScreen
defect: The new Back button uses UIScreen::OnBack, whose dialog result leaves EmuScreen with a black screen when backing out.
The Back button of the new InstallZipScreen finishes the dialog via OnBack, which EmuScreen does not handle for this dialog, leaving a black screen.

fix_subject: Fix more UV issues
defect: Step_TcFloatThrough drops the * 0.5f scaling of through-mode float UVs.

Step_TcFloatThrough stops halving through-mode float UVs while the VertexReader's new isThrough() check relies on an uninitialised vtype_, so through-mode float texture coordinates end up wrongly scaled.

fix_subject: Fix issue on EmuScreen after a crash
defect: The added UIContext::BeginFrame() call in the main render path is placed before the 'EmuScreen_NoFrame' backbuffer bind, so it runs (setting scissor and UI state) before the render target is bound.

The added UIContext::BeginFrame() call sits before the EmuScreen_NoFrame BindFramebufferAsRenderTarget, which then discards the UI state BeginFrame set up, breaking the UI drawn on frames without a present such as after a crash.

fix_subject: Fix scePsmfPlayerStart to not corrupt the stack.
defect: scePsmfPlayerCreate now returns ERROR_PSMF_NOT_FOUND instead of creating the player (reverting de1cb3f), so players are never created there and scePsmfPlayerStart falls into its broken creation path.

scePsmfPlayerCreate no longer creates the player: it returns ERROR_PSMF_NOT_FOUND when the player does not exist yet, so Create never succeeds and later calls run without a player (Start then dereferences a null psmfplayer).

fix_subject: Fix Windows build.
defect: The change uses the menu ID ID_CHEAT, which is not defined anywhere, in WndProc and UpdateCommands.
The new menu handling uses ID_CHEAT, which is not defined in resource.h, so the Windows build fails.

fix_subject: Prevent crashing the emu in stepVideo when things have gone very wrong.
defect: stepVideo now calls updateSwsFormat before the m_pFrame/m_pFrameRGB null checks, and updateSwsFormat dereferences m_pCodecCtx (possibly null, with m_sws_fmt possibly uninitialized) without checking it.
stepVideo now calls updateSwsFormat before any null checks, and updateSwsFormat dereferences m_pCodecCtx, crashing when the media context was never opened.

fix_subject: Fix UV error introduced in previous commit
defect: In non-through mode the change doubles the UV offsets uvscaleoff[2] and uvscaleoff[3] along with the scales.

For non-through mode the change doubles the UV offsets (uvscaleoff[2] and [3]) along with the scales, although only the scale should compensate for the halved texcoords, so texture coordinates are shifted.

fix_subject: Fix LogManager typo
defect: Removing _XBOX turned '!(MOBILE_DEVICE || _XBOX) || _DEBUG' into '!(MOBILE_DEVICE || _DEBUG)', which disables file and console logging in desktop debug builds and no longer matches the destructor's guard.
Rewriting the guard as !(MOBILE_DEVICE || _DEBUG) inverts the _DEBUG case, so desktop debug builds get no file, console or ring log listeners while the destructor still removes and deletes them.

fix_subject: Fix camera mirroring color issue, fix warning
defect: The new mirror loop reads b from line[x * 3 + 1] instead of line[x * 3 + 2], corrupting the blue channel.
In the new mirroring loop b is read from line[x*3+1] instead of line[x*3+2], corrupting the blue channel of mirrored camera images.

fix_subject: Fix initial thread stack, arg space and alignment.
defect: The new k0 block writes the initial stack at k0+0xc0 and the thread UID at the misaligned k0+0xca, instead of the UID at 0xc0 and the stack at 0xc8.
The new k0 block writes the thread UID at the unaligned offset 0xca and the initial stack at 0xc0, instead of the UID at 0xc0 and the stack at 0xc8.

fix_subject: Fix Android build cast error Remove gl command for texture 2d
defect: GetModifTime passes &buf.st_mtime of struct stat64 to localtime_r, which does not compile on Android where st_mtime is not a time_t.
GetModifTime passes &buf.st_mtime to localtime_r, but on Android stat64::st_mtime is not a time_t, so the Android build fails.

fix_subject: Replaced textures: Don't leak handles on failure, check allocation success
defect: The new early 'return;' after a short fread of the ZIM data in ReplacedTexture::Load leaks the FILE handle opened at the top of the function.
The new early return on a short ZIM fread in ReplacedTexture::Load leaks the FILE handle, since fp is never closed on that path.

fix_subject: Fix GPU block transfer
defect: The new DoBlockTransfer computes dstBasePtr and dstStride from transfersrc/transfersrcw instead of transferdst/transferdstw (copy-paste), so block transfers copy onto the source.
DoBlockTransfer computes dstBasePtr and dstStride from the transfersrc and transfersrcw registers, so the block copy targets the source instead of the destination.

fix_subject: Fix silly mistake with config saving.
defect: CConfig::Save now returns early when iniFile.Load fails, so when no ini exists yet (first run) the config is never written.
CConfig::Save now returns without saving when the existing ini cannot be read, so a missing config file (for example on first run) is never created.

fix_subject: Debugger: Fix crash in software renderer.
defect: The change moves CLUT lookup in the software sampler to SamplerID::cached.clut, but the debugger's GetCurrentTexture builds a SamplerID via ComputeSamplerID without setting cached.clut, so the sampler dereferences a null CLUT pointer and crashes.

The change moves the CLUT pointer into SamplerID::cached.clut, which only the binner fills, so the debugger's GetCurrentTexture builds a SamplerID with a null clut and the sampler crashes on CLUT textures.

fix_subject: vsgn x86 bugfix
defect: In the new Comp_Vsgn, XMM0 is zeroed once before the loop, but CMPEQSS/ANDNPS overwrite it each iteration, so later elements compare against garbage instead of 0.0f.
In the new Comp_Vsgn, XMM0 is zeroed once before the loop but CMPEQSS and ANDNPS overwrite it, so elements after the first are compared against a garbage value instead of 0.0f.

fix_subject: Fix typo in scePsmfPlayerStart() rewind.
defect: The new rewind branch in scePsmfPlayerStart sets readSize = size - mpegoffset and then immediately overwrites it with readSize = 0.
In the new rewind path of scePsmfPlayerStart, readSize is set to size - mpegoffset and then immediately overwritten with 0.

fix_subject: Fix wrong logging.
defect: The new stubs sceNpAuth_A1DE86F8 and sceNpService_0F8F5821 log themselves as 'sceNpAuth_4EC1F667' (copy-paste), producing misleading logs.
The new sceNpAuth_A1DE86F8 and sceNpService_0F8F5821 stubs log themselves as sceNpAuth_4EC1F667 (copy-paste), producing misleading UNIMPL logs.

fix_subject: Fix minor bug in StereoResampler debug display
defect: The moved debug statistic computes lastBufSize_ as (indexR - m_indexW) & INDEX_MASK, reversing the old (m_indexW - m_indexR) subtraction, so the displayed buffer fill level is wrong.
lastBufSize_ is computed as (indexR - m_indexW) & mask, with the operands reversed and in different units from the displayed m_maxBufsize, so the debug buffer fill shown is wrong.

fix_subject: Fix outdated renderpass name lookup table (debug info)
defect: The new rpTypeDebugNames table lists INPUT variants that the RenderPassType enum at this commit does not have (DEPTH=1, MULTIVIEW=2, MULTISAMPLE=4, BACKBUFFER=8), so most render passes get the wrong debug name.
The new rpTypeDebugNames table contains INPUT variants that RenderPassType no longer has (its bits are DEPTH, MULTIVIEW, MULTISAMPLE and BACKBUFFER), so render passes get the wrong debug names.

fix_subject: Fix audio regression: Don't "WalkCurve" on state OFF
defect: ADSREnvelope::Step now calls WalkCurve(type_) unconditionally before the state switch, so the envelope keeps walking (using stale rate_/type_, since SetState(STATE_OFF) returns early) even in STATE_OFF.
Step() now calls WalkCurve(type_) for every state including STATE_OFF, so a finished envelope keeps being walked with the release curve, changing height_ and causing audio artefacts.

fix_subject: Fix bug with watch window visibility pointing to the wrong bool
defect: The new ImWatchWindow::Draw passes &cfg.atracToolOpen to ImGui::Begin instead of &cfg.watchOpen, so closing the Watch window toggles the Atrac tool flag instead.
ImWatchWindow::Draw passes &cfg.atracToolOpen to ImGui::Begin instead of &cfg.watchOpen, so closing the watch window toggles the Atrac tool flag and the watch window cannot be closed.

fix_subject: Fix some comments and a string
defect: The combo-key list names the renamed key 'FastForward' while the KeyMap name, touch-control label and translation key use 'Fast-forward', so the combo key label is not translated.

The combo key list's UI name, which is also its translation key, becomes FastForward instead of Fast-forward, the name used for VIRTKEY_FASTFORWARD elsewhere and in the updated translations, so this label is shown untranslated.

fix_subject: Fix dpad analog overlap interaction
defect: The added early 'return' when the pointer is in analogPointerMask skips all touch processing, including TOUCH_UP, so a D-pad or button that grabbed the pointer before the overlapping stick never releases it.

The new early returns for pointers in analogPointerMask make buttons and the dpad ignore every event of that pointer, including TOUCH_UP and TOUCH_RELEASE_ALL, so a control that took the pointer before the overlapping analog stick stays stuck down.

fix_subject: Fix lookup table
defect: The new logicOps lookup table is not in GE logic-op enum order (CLEAR, AND, AND_REVERSE, COPY, ...), so most PSP logic ops map to the wrong GL logic op.
The new logicOps lookup table is not in GELogicOp order (for example index 1 maps to GL_SET instead of GL_AND), so most PSP logic ops map to the wrong GL logic op.

fix_subject: Fix PSP_UMD_TYPE_GAME...
defect: When consolidating the UMD type into the header, the change sets PSP_UMD_TYPE_GAME to 0x00 although the removed #define in sceUmd.cpp was 0x10, so games report the wrong UMD type.
Moving the UMD type constants into the header changed PSP_UMD_TYPE_GAME from 0x10 to 0x00, so the disc info reports the wrong UMD type for games.

fix_subject: Fix bug in FastLoadBoneMatrix where the wrong uniform could be dirtied
defect: The new FastLoadBoneMatrix dirties the next bone matrix with '(DIRTY_BONEMATRIX0 << (num / 12)) + 1', adding 1 to a bit flag instead of setting the next bit, so the wrong uniform is dirtied.
FastLoadBoneMatrix dirties (DIRTY_BONEMATRIX0 << n) + 1 for the second matrix instead of the next flag bit, so the wrong uniform is dirtied and the next bone matrix is not updated.

fix_subject: Fix slowdowns due to careless use of auto
defect: The change uses 'auto framebuffers = framebufferManager_->Framebuffers();', which copies the vector returned by const reference on every texture attach and CLUT load, causing slowdowns.
auto framebuffers = framebufferManager_->Framebuffers() copies the framebuffer vector on every texture attach and CLUT load, causing slowdowns.

fix_subject: Remove incorrect atrac decode ptr nullcheck.
defect: The added check returns SCE_KERNEL_ERROR_ILLEGAL_ADDR when outAddr is invalid, although a null outAddr is valid and used to skip decoded data.
The added outAddr validity check returns SCE_KERNEL_ERROR_ILLEGAL_ADDR for a null output address, which is a valid way to skip decoded data (the callee already handles outbuf == NULL).

fix_subject: Fix analog resize
defect: The new PSPStickDragDrop::SetSpacing stores s/3 but GetSpacing returns spacing_ unscaled, so get/set do not round-trip and resizing the analog head drifts.
PSPStickDragDrop::SetSpacing stores s/3 but GetSpacing returns the stored value unscaled, so each resize gesture (start = GetSpacing, then SetSpacing) shrinks the stick head by a factor of 3.

fix_subject: fix compiler warnings
defect: The new edit-confirm filter `confirmed = confirmed && IsKeyPressed(Enter) || IsKeyPressed(KeypadEnter)` parses as (confirmed && Enter) || KeypadEnter, so a keypad Enter press commits the watch edit even when InputText did not report confirmation.

Operator precedence error in the added 'confirmed = confirmed && IsKeyPressed(Enter) || IsKeyPressed(KeypadEnter)', which treats any keypad-Enter press as a confirmation regardless of the InputText result.

fix_subject: Fix a few more flips
defect: Removing the flip convention left BlitFramebuffer computing source and destination Y with the old bottom-up flip (renderHeight - ...) plus the flip block, so framebuffer blits come out vertically wrong under the new orientation.

Removing the flip special cases changed the framebuffer orientation convention, but BlitFramebuffer kept the old flipped Y coordinates for glBlitFramebuffer and its draw path now passes unflipped v coordinates, so blits come out wrong.

fix_subject: Fix IR profiling
defect: The new JitBlockCacheDebugInterface::GetBlockProfileStats is a non-pure virtual that returns empty stats, and the IR block cache, which reports SupportsProfiling(), never overrides it, so profiling always shows zero executions and time.

The added GetBlockProfileStats default stub silently returns empty stats, and IRBlockCache (which this commit makes report SupportsProfiling under IR_PROFILING) never overrides it, so IR profiling always shows zero executions and time.

fix_subject: Fix table checks in sceCcc.
defect: sceCccUTF8toSJIS and sceCccUTF16toSJIS check jis2ucsTable although they look up ucs2jisTable, and sceCccUTF16toUTF8 needlessly refuses to convert without a table.

UTF8toSJIS and UTF16toSJIS check jis2ucsTable although they read ucs2jisTable, and UTF16toUTF8 needlessly requires a table, so a missing ucs2jis table is dereferenced and valid UTF16-to-UTF8 calls fail.

fix_subject: Fix bug where readback buffers would be created too small sometimes.  Should help #10098
defect: CreateDownloadTempBuffer now creates the readback FBO with nvfb->width instead of nvfb->bufferWidth, so it is too small for the blit, which covers renderWidth = bufferWidth.
The newly enabled CreateDownloadTempBuffer creates the readback framebuffer with nvfb->width instead of nvfb->bufferWidth, so it can be too small for the readback copy.

fix_subject: Fix PAKFILE2.BIN and eboot logic
defect: The PAKFILE2.BIN bypass writes `bootpath == ...` (a comparison) instead of an assignment, so the alternative boot file is never selected.
The added PAKFILE2.BIN bypass writes 'bootpath == ...' (a comparison) instead of an assignment, so the alternate boot file is never selected.

fix_subject: Fix wrong type of parameter to UpdateRunLoop. Do not understand how this compiled.
defect: UpdateRunLoop is declared as taking a GraphicsContext* although its parameter is the InputState*, so the declaration matches neither the definition nor the callers.
UpdateRunLoop is declared as taking a GraphicsContext * although the parameter is the InputState, mismatching its definition.

The added SetError switches PointerWrap to MODE_MEASURE for any error including ERROR_WARNING, so a version-mismatch warning silently aborts savestate loading.

fix_subject: Fix sceFontGetFontList() error codes.

fix_subject: Avoid crashing when atrac3 decoders fail to init due to bad params.  Fixes Kosmodrones (though no music).
defect: For ATRAC3+ the change sets codecOpen_ = true even when atrac3p_alloc returns nullptr (missing block_align or bad channel count), so Decode then calls atrac3p_decode_frame with a null context and crashes.

fix_subject: Fix headless auto-compare when expected have \r's.

The new line comparator does not strip carriage returns, so expected files with CRLF line endings never match the emulator output and headless tests fail spuriously.

fix_subject: Fix a couple bad bounds checks in VAG/Mpeg.
defect: The new predict_nr bounds check divides by sizeof(s8), giving 10 instead of the 5 rows of f, so predict_nr values 5 to 9 still index past the filter table.
The added bound check uses sizeof(f) / sizeof(s8) = 10 instead of the 5 rows of f, so predict_nr values 5 to 9 still index past the coefficient table.

fix_subject: Fix black box in Dainiji_Super_Robot_Taisen_Z_Hakaihen
defect: Lowering the colour-test rounding offset in roundTo255thv from 0.5/255 to 0.49/255 makes colour-test comparisons fail for some colours, producing a black box in Super Robot Taisen Z Hakaihen.
Changing the color-test rounding offset from 0.5/255 to 0.49/255 in roundTo255thv breaks color-test comparisons and causes a black box in Super Robot Taisen Z.

fix_subject: Fix VAG looping.
defect: The change inverts the loop flag in sceSasSetVoice and sceSasSetVoicePCM (v.loop = loop ? false : true), so voices that request looping do not loop and vice versa.
sceSasSetVoice and sceSasSetVoicePCM invert the loop argument (loop ? false : true), so non-looping voices loop and looping voices do not.

fix_subject: Fix gl version parsing (sort of)
defect: The added version parsing does strcpy(buffer, versionStr) into a 64-byte buffer without a null check or length limit, so a null or long GL_VERSION string crashes or overflows the stack buffer.
The added GL version parsing strcpy's the GL_VERSION string into a 64-byte stack buffer with no length or null check, which can overflow or crash.

fix_subject: Fix loading of texture shaders
defect: The change moves textureShaderInfo.clear() from the start of LoadPostShaderInfo to after the loading loop, which wipes every texture shader just loaded and never clears stale entries before loading.
textureShaderInfo.clear() was moved after the scan loop, discarding every texture shader just loaded and leaving only 'Off'.

fix_subject: Fix lag generated by getting savegames on update() Also clear otherChoices_ vector, fixes crash when moving a window.
defect: AddOtherChoice pushes view pointers into otherChoices_ on every CreateViews without clearing it, so after a view recreation update() calls SetVisibility on deleted views (crash), and update() calls the heavy GetSaveDataDirectories every frame (lag).

AddOtherChoice appends to otherChoices_ on every CreateViews without clearing, so after views are recreated update() calls SetVisibility on deleted views (crash), and update() calls the heavy GetSaveDataDirectories every frame (lag).

fix_subject: Fix . button in the hostname/ip address editor
defect: OnPointClick sends NKCODE_PERIOD with KEY_CHAR, but with KEY_CHAR the code is read as a character, and NKCODE_PERIOD is not the character '.', so the dot button inserts the wrong character.
OnPointClick now sends NKCODE_PERIOD with KEY_CHAR, but with KEY_CHAR the key code is taken as a character, so the '.' button inserts a different character.

fix_subject: Some new NIDs, log fix, very minor bugfix.

In UpdateViewportAndProjection the Y offset and viewport height are scaled by renderWidthFactor_ instead of renderHeightFactor_.
