defect: The added gpuCommandsAtCallLevel statistic is incremented by the doubled cycle count (2 * commands) instead of the number of commands executed.
gpuCommandsAtCallLevel is incremented by 'executed', which is already doubled into CPU cycles, so the per-call-level command counts are twice the real number.

fix_subject: Fix further issues when the memstick dir is the PSP dir
defect: The added STRIP_PSP code checks startsWith(path, '/PSP') after the leading slash was already erased, so it never strips the PSP prefix, and the file handle's fileSystemFlags_ is never set.
The STRIP_PSP check tests startsWith(path, '/PSP') right after the leading '/' was erased, so it never matches; DirectoryFileHandle::fileSystemFlags_ is also never set.

fix_subject: softgpu: Implement stencil testing. Add some TODOs. Disable alpha blending when clear mode is active. GPUState: Fix incorrect stencil enum.
defect: The new software alpha blending is applied whenever alpha blending is enabled, including in clear mode, where the PSP does not blend.
The new software alpha blending path is applied even in clear mode, where the rasterizer should write the clear color directly.

fix_subject: Fix RotateUV. Apparently the rules are reversed in through mode.
defect: The change comments out the first RotateUVs check, which is the correct swap condition for one through-mode rectangle orientation, so those rectangles lose their UV rotation.
RotateUVs disables the first condition (v0.x > v2.x && v0.y < v2.y), which is correct in through mode, so rectangles with that orientation stop getting their UVs rotated.

fix_subject: Fix fake sceFontGetCharGlyphImage() overflowing.
defect: The fake sceFontGetCharGlyphImage memsets bytesPerLine*bufHeight*pixelFormat bytes, multiplying the buffer size by the pixel format code and overflowing the game's glyph buffer.
The fake sceFontGetCharGlyphImage memsets bytesPerLine*bufHeight*pixelFormat bytes, overrunning the glyph buffer by multiplying a byte count by the pixel format enum.

fix_subject: Work around crash in texture replacement. See #14252
defect: GetSamplingParams calls entry->CacheKey() whenever texture replacement is enabled, but GetFramebufferSamplingParams now passes a null entry, so it dereferences a null pointer and crashes.
GetSamplingParams dereferences entry (CacheKey, fullhash) whenever the replacer is enabled, but GetFramebufferSamplingParams in the same change passes nullptr, causing a crash.

fix_subject: Check the entire texture again, fixes wrong tex.
defect: The new QuickTexHash hashes only w columns per row and skips the bufw padding, which misses changes in swizzled or padded texture layouts (and steps backwards when bufw is smaller than w), so changed textures are not detected.
The new QuickTexHash rounds 4-bit and DXT formats up to one byte per pixel and computes a negative pad when w > bufw, so it hashes the wrong memory and misses texture changes (wrong textures).

fix_subject: Fix showing log windows on load with -l (initialization order).
defect: The change moves LogManager::Init and the console Open(hideLog, ...) call before the command-line loop, so the -l flag that clears hideLog is parsed too late and the log window is not shown.
The log console is opened with hideLog before the command line is parsed, so the -l option no longer shows the log window.

fix_subject: fix "unknown SDL joystick axes mapped to 'pad.X Axis-'" bug.
defect: ProcessInput looks up SDLJoyAxisMap and SDLJoyButtonMap with std::map operator[], so unmapped axes or buttons default to code 0 and are reported as the X axis (or keycode 0).
ProcessInput uses std::map operator[] on SDLJoyAxisMap and SDLJoyButtonMap, so unmapped axes and buttons insert and return 0 and are reported as axis X or key code 0.

fix_subject: Fix vertex preview when framebuf is an odd size.
defect: The new vertex preview sets glViewport(x, -y, fw, fh) and an ortho of the scaled content size (fw, fh) instead of the texture size, so vertices are misplaced when the framebuffer is scaled or offset.

The framebuffer vertex preview uses glViewport(x, -y, ...) and an ortho projection sized to the window content (fw, fh) instead of the framebuffer texture size, so the overlay is misplaced when the sizes differ.

fix_subject: Vulkan: Avoid crash on two backbuffer steps.
defect: The added SubmitPending(Pending) call before acquire ends and submits presentCmd when a second backbuffer render step occurs in a frame, after which vkBeginCommandBuffer is called on the still-pending presentCmd and crashes.

The added SubmitPending before acquire also ends and submits presentCmd when a second backbuffer render step occurs in a frame, after which vkBeginCommandBuffer is called on a pending command buffer and crashes.

fix_subject: Fix mainscreen icon
defect: The added dc.Begin() in ImageView::Draw restarts the UI draw batch (count reset without flush, pipeline/texture rebound), breaking drawing of the main-screen icon and previously batched UI.
ImageView::Draw now calls dc.Begin(), which rebinds the UI pipeline and samplers in the middle of drawing and breaks the main screen icon.

fix_subject: Fix name collision on iOS build
defect: The change introduces a global template named Rect, which collides with the Rect type from Apple system headers and breaks the iOS build.
The new template type is named Rect, which collides with the Rect type from Apple system headers and breaks the iOS build.

fix_subject: Qt: Fix png bug.
defect: The new Qt4 path calls image.convertToFormat(Format_ARGB32) without using its result (and omits it in pngLoadPtr), so the new ARGB-to-RGBA swizzle reads unconverted data and the buffer is sized for the unconverted image.

The Qt paths discard the result of convertToFormat, so the manual ARGB-to-RGBA loop runs on an unconverted image (and pngLoadPtr never converts at all), and the RGBA8888 branch is enabled for Qt 5.0 and 5.1 where that format does not exist.

fix_subject: Fix alarm test by not interrupting when disabled.
defect: The added unconditional __KernelSwitchOffThread on vblank reschedules even when interrupts are disabled.
hleEnterVblank calls __KernelSwitchOffThread unconditionally, rescheduling threads on vblank even when interrupts are disabled.

fix_subject: Fix crash when loading a ppdmp while another ppdmp is displaying
defect: The rewritten check calls gpu->PresentedThisFrame() without the null check the old condition had, crashing when gpu is null (loading a ppdmp while another is displayed).
The rewritten check calls gpu->PresentedThisFrame() without the gpu null check the old condition had, crashing when gpu is null (loading a ppdmp while another one displays).

fix_subject: fix return value / plug leak.
defect: The added null-shader check in CreateGraphicsPipeline returns false from a pointer-returning function and leaks the already allocated pipeline.
The added null-shader early return in CreateGraphicsPipeline leaks the newly allocated pipeline and returns false from a pointer-returning function.

fix_subject: Fix a potential crash/race condition.
defect: The added __KernelReSchedule inside the loop over chan.waitingThreads can re-enter __AudioWakeThreads and modify the vector while it is being iterated, causing a crash or race.

The change calls __KernelReSchedule inside the loop over chan.waitingThreads; a reschedule can run pending events that re-enter __AudioWakeThreads and modify the vector, invalidating the waitInfo reference and loop index.

fix_subject: Fix regression in break-on-load functionality
defect: The added guard makes Core_Break a no-op unless the core is in CORE_RUNNING_CPU, so the loaders' Core_Break(start-break) in CORE_POWERUP no longer breaks on load.
The new early return in Core_Break for any state other than CORE_RUNNING_CPU turns the loaders' Core_Break('start-break') call during CORE_POWERUP into a no-op, breaking break-on-load.

fix_subject: Fix compilation error.
defect: The added if(Memory::IsValidAddress(bufferPtr) in sceNetEtherNtostr is missing a closing parenthesis, a compile error.
The added if (Memory::IsValidAddress(bufferPtr) in sceNetEtherNtostr is missing a closing parenthesis, so sceNet.cpp does not compile.

fix_subject: Fix bug causing clickables not to highlight on mousedown in SDL builds
defect: The new Clickable::Key clears down_ for any key event when the view is not focused, so the mouse-button key event SDL sends after the touch-down cancels the highlight.

The rewritten Clickable::Key clears down_ on every key event when the view is not focused, so the mouse-button KeyInput that SDL sends right after the touch-down resets the pressed state and clickables do not highlight.

fix_subject: Fix up secPower a bit
defect: The new scePowerRegisterCallback and scePowerUnregisterCallback index powerCbSlots with an unchecked guest slot (e.g. -1 for auto), writing and reading out of bounds, and never clear the slot.

scePowerRegisterCallback indexes powerCbSlots[slot] with an unchecked guest value (slot -1 means auto-select, so it writes out of bounds), and scePowerUnregisterCallback neither bounds-checks slotId nor clears the slot.

fix_subject: Found a bug where we tried to look up queue family -1 when initializing the frame profiler.
defect: The added lookup of GetQueueFamilyProperties(GetGraphicsQueueFamilyIndex()) in VulkanProfiler::Init runs before the queue family is chosen, indexing queue family -1.
Init now calls GetQueueFamilyProperties(GetGraphicsQueueFamilyIndex()), but Init runs from CreateDevice before ChooseQueue sets the graphics queue family, so it looks up queue family -1.

fix_subject: Fix silly filesystem mounting bug introduced in #14638
defect: The added pspFileSystem.UnmountAll() in __IoShutdown unmounts every filesystem, including mounts owned by others, breaking filesystem mounting.

__IoShutdown now calls pspFileSystem.UnmountAll(), which also removes mounts sceIo does not own (the disc and umd mounts made by the loader), so they are gone after an HLE reset that re-runs __IoInit.

fix_subject: Fix bugs in MIDI In
defect: The new MIDI callback decodes MIM_DATA bytes from dwParam2 (the timestamp) instead of dwParam1, and the non-Windows stubs lack the includes they need.
MIM_DATA bytes are read from dwParam2 (the timestamp) instead of dwParam1, and the non-Windows stub branch lacks the includes it needs (midi_input.h, vector, string).

fix_subject: Fix multiple windows UI translations.
defect: The added MainWindow::TranslateMenus() in UpdateUI runs from the emu thread on every UI update, retranslating already translated menu text used as keys.

UpdateUI now calls MainWindow::TranslateMenus on every UI update, from the emu thread and at least on start and stop, but TranslateMenus uses the current menu text as its key, so repeated calls re-translate translated text and append accelerators again.

fix_subject: Fixed rendering glitch caused by calling ReadFramebuffersToMem for unfinished framebuffers (non-displayed framebuffers are now read at the beginning of next frame);
defect: The added ReadFramebufferToMemory call in SetRenderFrameBuffer reads the current framebuffer mid-frame on every call and unbinds the FBO without rebinding it, causing rendering glitches.

SetRenderFrameBuffer calls ReadFramebufferToMemory on the current render target whenever framebuffer state changes, reading unfinished framebuffers and leaving the FBO unbound (the read ends with fbo_unbind) when the same target stays current.

fix_subject: Improve VCMP instruction with option for E. Add comment to le JIT about how the VCMP crashes on ARM11, with commented code.

The default argument round_to_zero = false is placed on the out-of-line VCVT definition in the .cpp instead of the header declaration, so callers in other files such as the four-argument call in ArmCompFPU.cpp do not compile.

fix_subject: Fix another D3D11 bug, still no dice...
defect: The new R8G8B8A8_UNORM text path builds pixels as (bAlpha | 0xffffff00), which on little-endian puts the glyph coverage in the red byte and forces alpha to 0xff instead of white with alpha = coverage.
The new R8G8B8A8 fallback writes (bAlpha) | 0xffffff00, putting the glyph alpha in the red byte and 0xFF in the alpha byte.

fix_subject: Fix another D3D11 bug, still no dice...
defect: The added HLSL_D3D11 vsTexCol shader computes mul(float4(pos,1), WorldViewProj), i.e. the transposed matrix, although the D3D11 backend uploads the GL-style column-major matrix raw into a constant buffer.

The new D3D11 texture-color vertex shader computes mul(float4(Position, 1.0), WorldViewProj), copied from D3D9, which is the wrong order for the matrix as the D3D11 backend uploads it raw into a constant buffer.

fix_subject: Fix another D3D11 bug, still no dice...
defect: The dynamic uniform buffer is created with D3D11_BIND_CONSTANT_BUFFER but the change also creates a shader resource view on it (invalid for a constant buffer) as the way to expose uniforms, so uniforms never reach the vertex shader.

The dynamic uniform buffer, created with D3D11_BIND_CONSTANT_BUFFER, gets a ShaderResourceView (invalid for a constant buffer) instead of being bound as a constant buffer, so shaders never receive the uniforms.

fix_subject: Fix register memcheck to respect offset.
defect: The new MemCheckAsm compares and passes the raw base register xaddr_ to the memcheck without adding offset_, so register-based memory breakpoints check the wrong address.
MemCheckAsm compares the base register xaddr_ against the breakpoint addresses and passes it to JitMemCheck without adding offset_, so memory breakpoints on reg+offset accesses miss or misfire.

fix_subject: Crash fix for Symbian. Will have to put up with crummy music a little bit longer.
defect: Moving MainAudio into a separate QThread crashes on Symbian, a supported Qt platform.
Moving MainAudio onto a separate QThread crashes on Symbian.

fix_subject: Fix a couple of crashes
defect: HttpImageFileView starts a download whose callback is bound to this, but its destructor does not cancel the download, so a callback after the view is destroyed writes to freed memory.
HttpImageFileView starts a download whose callback is bound to this, but its destructor does not cancel the download, so a view destroyed mid-download has the callback run on a freed object.

fix_subject: Vulkan vertex cache: Fix memory leak
defect: The added vai_.Clear() in DestroyDeviceObjects drops the owned VertexArrayInfoVulkan pointers without deleting them, leaking them on every device loss.
The added vai_.Clear() drops the map's raw VertexArrayInfoVulkan pointers without deleting them, leaking them on every device loss.

defect: Converting stencil_ps to a raw string left the STR(CONST_PS_STENCILVALUE) concatenation inside the literal, so the shader text contains register(c" STR(CONST_PS_STENCILVALUE) ") and fails to compile.
Inside the new raw string literal the STR(CONST_PS_STENCILVALUE) concatenation becomes literal text, so the stencil pixel shader source is invalid HLSL.

The new ins path with an immediate rs maps rt with gpr.MapReg(rt) and then modifies it without MAP_DIRTY, so the result is never written back.

fix_subject: Bug fix for scepsmf.

Streams are created with the channel counters before they are incremented, and the counters start at -1, so the first video and audio streams get channel -1.

UnsyncKey computes retval from UnsyncKeyEvent but returns true unconditionally, so every key, including volume keys, is reported as consumed.

fix_subject: Fix touch events on mobile Windows 10
defect: The new pointer handlers pass the raw Windows PointerId as the touch id, which on mobile Windows 10 is a large arbitrary number, so touch ids overflow the small-index assumptions (1 << input.id, MAX_POINTERS) of the UI and touch input breaks.

The new pointer handlers pass the raw Windows PointerId as the touch id (assumed to start at 1) and call SetPointerCapture, but on Windows 10 Mobile the ids are arbitrary and capture is unusable, so touch input breaks there.

fix_subject: Fix vrnd to the current understanding
defect: The new vrnd_generate computes the E increment with a guessed chain of addition_overflows tests that does not match the PSP hardware RNG sequence.
vrnd_generate updates the E carry part with a guessed overflow formula evaluated after C and D are already updated, which does not match PSP hardware output.

fix_subject: Fix "Improved compatibility of sceGeListEnQueue: verify that stackDepth < 256"
defect: The new sceGeListEnqueue check rejects lists when args->size >= 256 instead of checking args->numStacks, so it tests the wrong field of PspGeListArgs.
The new check rejects lists with args->size >= 256 instead of checking args->numStacks, the stack depth the change meant to verify, so valid lists can fail with SCE_KERNEL_ERROR_INVALID_SIZE.

fix_subject: Fix Sonic's ArmEmitter changes. FastMem should work now.
defect: In the new WriteStoreOp the break for TYPE_REG/TYPE_IMMSREG sits inside if (!SpecialOp), so register-offset halfword/signed loads and stores fall through to the default case and emit BKPT instead of the instruction.
In the new WriteStoreOp the TYPE_REG/TYPE_IMMSREG case breaks only inside if (!SpecialOp), so register-offset LDRH/STRH/LDRSB/LDRSH fall through to the default branch and emit BKPT.

fix_subject: Remove wrong alignment check on relocations. Add a comment.
defect: The new robustness check skips every relocation whose target address is not 4-byte aligned ((addr & 3)), although misaligned relocations are legal in PSP binaries, so valid relocations are silently dropped.
The new (addr & 3) check rejects misaligned relocation addresses as bad and skips them, but misaligned relocations are legitimate, so they are no longer applied.

fix_subject: Fix exiting from framedump playback while paused inside a display list
defect: The new Replay_Unload sets g_opToExec to Done and notifies opFinishWait, but the replay thread waits on the predicate g_opDone, which stays false, so the thread never wakes and replayThread.join() hangs when exiting while paused inside a display list.
Replay_Unload sets g_opToExec to Done and notifies opFinishWait, but the replay thread waits there on the predicate g_opDone, which stays false, so the following join() hangs.

fix_subject: GL bugfix, log cleanup
defect: The new Spongebob depth-fail special case passes GL_ADD (a texture-environment constant) instead of GL_FUNC_ADD as the blend equations to SetBlendAndMask, giving an invalid blend equation.
The new Spongebob special case passes GL_ADD, which is not a blend equation, to SetBlendAndMask instead of GL_FUNC_ADD.

fix_subject: fix a wrong parameter
defect: The change passes exp, a PostfixExpression object, to sprintf's %s instead of the C string str, which is undefined behaviour and prints garbage or crashes when the size expression fails to parse.
The size-expression error message now passes exp, a PostfixExpression object, to sprintf's %s instead of the string str, which is undefined behaviour.

fix_subject: Fix crash on Return to Menu in Symbian. We don't want to free the executable code (actually a Chunk+Heap) using same method we use to free memory pages (delete). This would be the same situation on jailbroken iOS and WP. Now the JIT code is always allocated and never freed on Symbian.
defect: The new Symbian AllocateExecutableMemory hands out blocks from an RChunk heap (Alloc per call), but the JIT still releases code space through the munmap-based free path, so returning to the menu frees heap memory the wrong way and crashes.
On Symbian, executable memory now comes from a chunk heap (g_code_heap->Alloc), but FreeCodeSpace still releases it with FreeMemoryPages, which munmaps it and crashes on Return to Menu.

fix_subject: Fix that weird unordered compare mode, hopefully
defect: The newly added FCmp case for IRFpCompareMode::NotEqualUnordered computes a != b, but IRCompFPU maps the MIPS c.un (unordered only) compare to this mode, so fpcond is set for any unequal pair instead of only when an operand is NaN.
The added NotEqualUnordered case computes fpcond as f[src1] != f[src2], but that mode is MIPS c.un, which is true only when an operand is NaN.

fix_subject: Fix the touch event filtering to not filter out touch events in the case of mouse control being enabled
defect: The new branch in EmuScreen::touch drops every non-up touch event whenever mouse control is enabled, including genuine touchscreen input, instead of only mouse-generated events.
The new branch in EmuScreen::touch drops every non-up touch event while bMouseControl is on, including real touchscreen input, not only mouse events.

fix_subject: Fix the save loading for God Eater Burst and Gundam VS Gundam NP
defect: The new GetFilesList reads the number of file entries from fileListAddr+12 instead of +0, so for games where the two fields differ the file list is processed with the wrong count and save loading fails (God Eater Burst, Gundam VS Gundam NP).
The new GetFilesList reads the file count from fileListAddr+12 instead of +0, which is wrong for games such as God Eater Burst and Gundam VS Gundam NP.

fix_subject: Fix softgpu's 4444 color conversion.
defect: When moving the texel decoders into Colors.h, DecodeRGBA4444 was rewritten to take red from bits 12-15 and alpha from bits 0-3, reversing the channel order of the previously correct Rasterizer.cpp version.
DecodeRGBA4444 takes red from the top nibble and alpha from the bottom, reversing the PSP 4444 layout (red in bits 0-3) that RGBA8888To4444 in the same file uses.

fix_subject: Fix typo breaking delete button in OSK.
defect: The rewritten delete-button condition uses the same ternary as the select branch (CTRL_CROSS when preference is not circle, else CTRL_CIRCLE) instead of the opposite button, so the delete branch is unreachable and the OSK delete button no longer works.
The rewritten delete-button condition tests the same button as the select condition before it, so delete can never trigger.

fix_subject: Fix bugs in deletion. Delete redundant functions.
defect: The new loop in PerformDeletes destroys buffersWithAllocs_ but then clears buffers_ instead of buffersWithAllocs_, so the VMA buffers stay in the list and are destroyed again on the next PerformDeletes (double free); Take() also never moves the new list.
After destroying buffersWithAllocs_, PerformDeletes clears buffers_ instead of buffersWithAllocs_, so those VMA buffers are destroyed again on the next call.

fix_subject: softgpu: Cleanup CLUT lookup code and fix a critical bug related to it. Also added semi-working fast texture storage mode support.
defect: The new CLUT lookup masks the index with 0xE before OR-ing the start position, discarding bit 0 and all bits above 3, so CLUT8/CLUT4 textures read the wrong palette entries.
The new CLUT lookups mask the index with 0xE, dropping bit 0 and every bit above 3, so wrong palette entries are used.

fix_subject: Fix crash in non-buffered rendering.
defect: The new desktop depth blit calls fbo_bind_for_read(currentRenderVfb_->fbo) without checking that the previous framebuffer has an FBO, so in non-buffered rendering (fbo set to 0, as the diff context shows) it dereferences a null FBO and crashes.
The new depth blit binds currentRenderVfb_->fbo for reading without checking it is non-zero, but in non-buffered mode the fbo is destroyed and set to 0, so the blit crashes.

fix_subject: fix
defect: The change adds an '#ifdef USE_DIRECTX' before the NullGpu/SoftGpu includes with no matching #endif and an unguarded 'new DIRECTX9_GPU()' case, which breaks compilation (unterminated conditional, undefined type) on non-DirectX builds.
The change adds an unterminated #ifdef USE_DIRECTX around the NullGpu/SoftGpu includes and an unconditional new DIRECTX9_GPU() whose header is only included under USE_DIRECTX, breaking the build.

fix_subject: Correct a crash on a missing kernel object.
defect: The new log message calls t->GetTypeName() inside the branch taken when t == nullptr, dereferencing a null pointer when a handle slot is occupied but empty.
The new log message calls t->GetTypeName() inside the branch taken when t == nullptr, dereferencing a null pointer.

fix_subject: Fix the fix
defect: The change moves #include <signal.h> into the x86 branch, which uses asm int 3, leaving the non-x86 Crash() that uses kill(getpid(), SIGINT) without the header, breaking non-x86 non-Windows builds.
The change moves #include <signal.h> from IOS/MIPS into the x86 branch, while kill() and SIGINT are used in the non-x86 branch, so IOS/MIPS (and other non-x86 builds) lose the declarations.

fix_subject: Vulkan image readback: Fix a couple scary cases of wrong argument order in image transitions, leading to transitioning 0 mips
defect: In PerformReadback the change inserts the new mip arguments after the aspect (VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 1) instead of before it, so the backbuffer transitions get aspect 0 and a wrong mip range.
In PerformReadback the two backbuffer TransitionImageLayout2 calls pass (aspect, 0, 1) instead of (0, 1, aspect), so the mip/level arguments are wrong and 0 mips are transitioned.

fix_subject: Fix typo-bug when setting sampler uniforms, tweak fudge factors.
defect: The new code sets the sampler uniforms with glUniform1d (a double-precision setter) instead of glUniform1i, so the tex and pal samplers are never bound to units 0 and 1.
Sampler uniforms are set with glUniform1d (a double uniform setter) instead of glUniform1i, so the tex/pal samplers are not bound to units 0/1.

fix_subject: Fix typo making the first line wrap wrong.
defect: skipWrap is initialized to true, so on the first line the next word is always treated as one character long and the first line never wraps correctly.
skipWrap is initialised to true, so on the first line every word is treated as one character wide and the first line wraps wrongly.

fix_subject: Fix VFPU bugs thanks to new tests.
defect: The change implements the opcode at VFPU7 slot 24 as vrexp2 via a new Int_VRexp2, but that slot is vuc2i, so the instruction seen in Brave Story computes an exponential instead of a conversion.
The change wires a new Int_VRexp2 interpreter to the tableVFPU7 slot 24 encoding, which is actually vuc2i, so that opcode is executed as a reciprocal exponent instead of a conversion.

fix_subject: Fix bug found by clang warning
defect: memset(info, 0, sizeof(info)) on the array parameter float info[4] clears only sizeof(float*) bytes, leaving part of the output uninitialized.
GetGestureInfo zeroes the output with memset(info, 0, sizeof(info)), where info is a pointer parameter, so only 4 or 8 bytes instead of 16 are cleared.

fix_subject: Fix touch buttons that got broken. Also, make the onscreen turbo a pure unthrottle, I don't understand how the other is supposed to work heh (checking iFrameLimit?)
defect: The new legacy_touch_mapping maps PAD_BUTTON_BACK instead of PAD_BUTTON_SELECT to CTRL_SELECT (the removed table used SELECT), and the touch buttons now go to fakeInputState so the onscreen unthrottle is no longer seen in input.pad_buttons.

The new legacy_touch_mapping maps PAD_BUTTON_BACK instead of PAD_BUTTON_SELECT to CTRL_SELECT (and touch buttons now only reach fakeInputState), so the on-screen Select and special touch buttons break.

fix_subject: Fixed missing ")"
defect: The new condition in GetCodesList is missing a closing parenthesis, so CwCheat.cpp does not compile.
The rewritten if condition is missing a closing parenthesis, so CwCheat.cpp does not compile.

fix_subject: Fix double free when saving.
defect: Clear() deletes every saveDataList[i].texture, including entries that share noSaveIcon->texture, and then deletes noSaveIcon->texture again, a double free when saving.
Clear() deletes every saveDataList[i].texture even when it is the shared noSaveIcon->texture, and then deletes noSaveIcon->texture again, causing a double free.

fix_subject: Fix issues with line breaks in system font
defect: The new Win32 text drawer measures and draws with GetTextExtentPoint32 and ExtTextOut, which do not handle line breaks, so multi-line UI strings are measured and rendered as one line.
The new Win32 TextDrawer measures and renders with GetTextExtentPoint32/ExtTextOut, which ignore line breaks, so strings containing newlines are measured and drawn as a single line.

fix_subject: Fix typo
defect: The new 'All supported file types' filter uses the pattern '*zip' instead of '*.zip', so it matches any name ending in 'zip' rather than .zip files.
The new 'All supported file types' filter lists the pattern *zip instead of *.zip, so it matches any name ending in 'zip' rather than .zip files.

fix_subject: Fix dumb copy and paste error.
defect: The new hard-coded Enter key is added to confirmKeys only if it is absent from cancelKeys (a copy-paste slip), so it is duplicated when already a confirm key and not added when it is a cancel key.
The new hard-coded Enter check searches cancelKeys instead of confirmKeys before appending NKCODE_ENTER to confirmKeys, a copy-paste error that can duplicate Enter or wrongly omit it.

fix_subject: Back out wrong change. Leaving better error handling for later.
defect: Adding '&& depal' makes SetDepalTexture(VK_NULL_HANDLE) a no-op, so boundDepal_ is never cleared and later non-depal draws keep a stale depal image view bound (and the fragment shader state is not dirtied).
SetDepalTexture now ignores a null depal, so a previously bound depal texture can never be cleared and the fragment shader state is not dirtied when depal is turned off.

fix_subject: ir-jit: Fix bugs in rounding
defect: The new FRound, FCeil and FFloor interpreter cases write the integer result to mips->r[dest] (GPR) instead of mips->fs[dest] (FPR).
The new FRound, FCeil and FFloor interpreter cases write the integer result to mips->r[dest] (a GPR) instead of mips->fs[dest] (the FPU register).

fix_subject: Fix crash in headless GPU tests/bad settings.
defect: EndFrame dereferences shaderInfo->isUpscalingFilter without checking that GetPostShaderInfo found the shader, so a post-shader name other than Off that is not found (empty in headless) crashes.

EndFrame dereferences shaderInfo->isUpscalingFilter without checking that GetPostShaderInfo found the shader, crashing when sPostShaderName is not 'Off' but names no existing shader (e.g. empty in headless).

fix_subject: Fix broken translations
defect: The moved Rotation popup passes the Graphics category (gr->GetName()) for its choice strings, but Landscape/Portrait are translated under Controls, so the choices are no longer translated.
The rotation PopupMultiChoice moved here uses the Graphics category (gr->GetName()) for its choice strings, whereas they are translated under Controls, so the options show untranslated.

fix_subject: Fix savestates from before v0.9.6-536-g62e9e42.
defect: Registering LoadExecForKernel and SysMemForKernel in the middle of RegisterAllModules shifts the indices of all later modules, which breaks savestates made before the change.
Registering LoadExecForKernel and SysMemForKernel in the middle of RegisterAllModules shifts the module indices stored in savestates, breaking older savestates.

fix_subject: samplerjit: Correct wrong bufw at mip levels.
defect: The new Jit_PrepareData*Offsets signatures take no level, so the offsets computed for the second mip level (U1/V1) use the level-0 bufw.
The new mip-level offset computation (Jit_PrepareDataOffsets called for VEC_U1/VEC_V1) always multiplies by the base level's bufw, giving wrong texel offsets for mip level 1.

fix_subject: Just log and continue when EI_CLASS is wrong.
defect: The new EI_CLASS check rejects ELFs whose class byte is 0 (as produced by emulator-only patches) that loaded before, so those games no longer start.
The new e_ident check rejects ELFs whose EI_CLASS is 0 (ELFCLASSNONE), so games with such headers (e.g. emulator-only patched ELFs) that loaded before no longer boot.

fix_subject: Fix jit VDot mapping vd incorrectly to a quad.
defect: Comp_VDot fetches dregs with the source vector size (GetVectorRegs(dregs, sz, vd)) though vdot writes a single value, and the new constant zero is defined as -1.0f.
Comp_VDot computes dregs with GetVectorRegs(dregs, sz, vd), interpreting the single-register destination vd as a vector of size sz, so the wrong destination register is mapped.

fix_subject: Fix shader debug description issue.
defect: FragmentShaderDesc reports ReplaceLogic for clear-mode shader IDs, because clear IDs leave the logic-op bits 0, which differs from GE_LOGIC_COPY.
The new ReplaceLogic description fires for clear-mode shader IDs, where the logic-op bits are 0 rather than GE_LOGIC_COPY, so the debug description is wrong.

fix_subject: Fix a logic error in module load validation.
defect: The condition module_start_func != 0 || module_start_func != -1 is always true, so the start-function checks and warnings run even when there is no start function.
The new check module_start_func != 0 || module_start_func != -1 is always true, so the start-function validation warnings run even when there is no start function.

fix_subject: Fix crash loading old savestates.
defect: __SasDoState calls RestoreRegisterEvent with sasMixEvent even when the restored value is -1 (old savestate loaded and then resaved), which crashes on load.
After loading an old (version 1) savestate sasMixEvent is -1, and resaving then loading writes and restores -1 via RestoreRegisterEvent unconditionally, which crashes.

fix_subject: Crash fix and more scanning
defect: The new clearFunctions() clears the functions map but leaves visibleFunctionAddresses and strayLines, so onPaint later dereferences functions.end() for a stale address and crashes.

The new clearFunctions() clears only the functions map, leaving visibleFunctionAddresses and strayLines referring to removed functions, so drawing dereferences functions.find(...) at end() and crashes.

fix_subject: Bugfix, remove hack
defect: A debugging 'return 0;' at the top of PSPSaveDialog::Init makes the whole save dialog initialization unreachable, so savedata dialogs do nothing.
A debugging 'return 0;' was added at the top of PSPSaveDialog::Init, so the save dialog never initialises or processes its parameters.

fix_subject: Fix checkbox bug introduced in #11758. Fixes #11761.
defect: CheckBox::Toggled() returns the pointer toggle_ (always true when set) instead of *toggle_, so every checkbox draws as checked.
CheckBox::Toggled() returns the pointer toggle_ converted to bool instead of *toggle_, so every checkbox with a target shows as checked.

fix_subject: Avoid a crash in the GE debugger.
defect: The new BindFramebufferColor dereferences currentRenderVfb_->fbo without a null check, so the GE debugger's GetCurrentTexture -> SetTexture(true) path crashes when no render target is current.
The new BindFramebufferColor dereferences currentRenderVfb_->fbo when making the self-texturing copy, but currentRenderVfb_ is null when called from the GE debugger, causing a crash.

fix_subject: Fix the chat window closing on pressing the X key.
defect: UnsyncKey now runs the escape/close-chat branch even when UIScreen::UnsyncKey already consumed the key, so typing a key bound as cancel (e.g. X) into the chat box closes the chat.
UnsyncKey now closes the chat window on any escape-mapped key even when UIScreen already handled the key, so typing a key such as X that is bound to cancel closes the chat.

fix_subject: Bugs fixed + enabled MIPSTracer on Mac, desktop Linux and OpenBDS
defect: WARN_LOG passes the std::string logging_path to a %s format through varargs, which is undefined behaviour and rejected by clang.
The new warning passes the std::string logging_path to a %s format argument, which is undefined behaviour (and a compile error on some compilers).

fix_subject: Fix HW T&L crash in FF type-0
defect: The generated GLSL uses the float literal 1.0f, which is invalid in GLSL 1.10 / GLSL ES and makes the hardware-transform vertex shader fail to compile.
The generated GLSL line 'v_texcoord.y = 1.0f - v_texcoord.y;' uses an f-suffixed float literal, which GLSL 1.10/ES 2.0 rejects, so the shader fails to compile whenever flipV is set.

fix_subject: Fix GLES check
defect: logicOpSupported is set from the compile-time USING_GLES2 macro, so a build without that macro running on a GLES context reports logic-op support it does not have.
logicOpSupported is set by the compile-time USING_GLES2 macro, so desktop builds running on a GLES context wrongly report logic-op support.

fix_subject: Fix exit replacement hooks.
defect: When hooking function exit, each jr ra found at address + offset is replaced by writing the hook at the function start (address) instead of at address + offset.
When hooking function exit, the loop finds jr ra at address + offset but writes the replacement at the function start address, so exit hooks replace the wrong instruction.

fix_subject: Fix type error in minor ARM64 optimization, which some compilers don't like.
defect: The ARM64 AnyZeroSignBit(Vec4F32) passes the float32x4_t value.v to vmaxvq_s32 instead of the reinterpreted ival, a type error that strict compilers reject.
The ARM64 shortcut in AnyZeroSignBit(Vec4F32) calls vmaxvq_s32 on value.v (a float32x4_t) instead of the reinterpreted ival, a type error that some compilers reject.

fix_subject: Fix HLE logging for args > 8.
defect: For arguments beyond the eighth, the stack address is computed from the uninitialized regval instead of reg, reading from a garbage address.
For arguments beyond the eighth, the stack read uses the uninitialised regval instead of reg to compute the offset, giving undefined behaviour and wrong stack reads.

fix_subject: Fix silly typo
defect: The 32-bit x86 path calls ABI_CallFunctionA with negSin2, which is not declared at that point, so the 32-bit build fails to compile.
On 32-bit x86 the sin/cos call uses negSin2, which is not declared at that point (and is the wrong variable), so the build fails there.

fix_subject: Fix bug in word wrapper
defect: WrapBeforeWord reads out_[out_.size() - 1] when out_ may be empty, an out-of-bounds access at the first word.
WrapBeforeWord reads out_[out_.size() - 1] even when out_ is still empty (first word wider than the line), an out-of-range access.

fix_subject: Fix glInvalidateFramebuffer in EmuScreen.
defect: glInvalidateFramebuffer is called with count 3 on a 3-element array holding only two attachments, passing a zero (invalid) attachment enum.
glInvalidateFramebuffer is called with count 3 on a two-entry initializer, so the third attachment is 0, an invalid enum.

fix_subject: Fix by hrydgard
defect: fwrite(&utfstring, length + 1, length + 3, f) writes the std::string object and reads far past it instead of writing the character data.
fwrite(&utfstring, length + 1, length + 3, f) writes the bytes of the std::string object itself with a size and count far beyond it, a buffer over-read that also writes garbage instead of the path.

fix_subject: Almost all alu recompiled Current issues: 	Comp_RType3(min/max): Can't select start in disgaea 	Comp_ShiftType(srl/srlv?): Crash ridge racer 2
defect: The new min/max code writes rd = rs before comparing rs with rt, so when rd == rt the comparison uses the clobbered value and gives a wrong result (Disgaea fails).
The new PPC max/min code writes rd = rs before comparing rs with rt, so when rd and rt map to the same register the compare sees the clobbered value and the result is wrong.

fix_subject: Fix two OSD rendering bugs (messages with text2 didn't render it, text alignment with icon)
defect: The new Show(type, text, text2, ...) overload forwards an empty string instead of text2, so the second text line is dropped.
The new inline Show(type, text, text2, duration, id) forwards an empty string instead of text2, so the second text line is silently dropped.

fix_subject: Fix NEON compilation error on strict compilers. Fixes #18688
defect: The NEON path stores the uint32x4_t results of vdupq_n_u32, vandq_u32 and vld1q_u32 in int32x4_t variables, a type error that strict compilers reject.
The new NEON path stores vdupq_n_u32/vandq_u32 results (uint32x4_t) in int32x4_t variables, which strict compilers reject as an invalid conversion, breaking the ARM NEON build.

fix_subject: Fix small mistake in Choice layout with image
defect: Choice::GetContentDimensionsBySpec with an image and text leaves out the 6px gap and does not subtract the image width from the text's available width, inconsistent with Draw.

When a Choice has both image and text, the new measurement neither counts the 6px gap after the image nor subtracts the image width from the text's available width, so the measured size disagrees with what Draw lays out.

fix_subject: Fixed PortManager fallback Cleanup issue when exiting PPSSPP due to early WSACleanup
defect: The global PortManager destructor's fallback cleanup (Clear and Restore through miniupnpc) runs after WSACleanup at exit on Windows, so the UPnP calls fail and the mappings are not removed.

The new global g_PortManager's destructor calls Clear() and Restore(), which issue UPnP network requests at process exit after Winsock has already been cleaned up, so they fail and the router's port mappings are left behind.

fix_subject: Fix a minor typo.
defect: th is read with getTextureWidth instead of getTextureHeight, so the mip-height check is wrong.
The new bad-mipmap-size check reads th with getTextureWidth(i) instead of getTextureHeight(i), so the height check compares the width and misdetects mip sizes.

fix_subject: Fix one possible (reproducible!) startup crash in IRJit. May help #8848
defect: The new member size_ of IRBlockCache is never initialized, so GetBlock before the first AllocateBlock compares against garbage and can return an invalid pointer.

The new IRBlockCache member size_ is never initialized (no constructor sets it), so GetBlock can bounds-check against garbage and return a pointer past the end of blocks_ before the first AllocateBlock, crashing at startup.

fix_subject: Fix minor bug where we didn't clear dirtyUniforms if early-outing from UpdateUniform.
defect: The new UpdateUniforms early-outs without clearing dirtyUniforms and tests the lighting/material bits against the unmasked dirtyUniforms after dropping their -1 location guards, leaving stale bits and making redundant uniform uploads.

The rewritten UpdateUniforms returns early before resetting dirtyUniforms, leaving stale dirty bits, and its material/ambient checks test dirtyUniforms instead of the availability-masked dirty, dropping the old != -1 guards.

fix_subject: Fix save status
defect: Adding the stackAddr member to DisplayList changed the layout of a struct that GPUCommon::DoState serializes with DoArray, without bumping the savestate section version, breaking loading of older savestates.

Adding stackAddr to DisplayList changes the layout of a struct that GPUCommon::DoState serializes raw with p.DoArray(dls), without bumping the savestate section version, so existing savestates load misaligned.

fix_subject: Fix typo breaking next-slot keybinding.
defect: In VIRTKEY_NEXT_SLOT the change wrote NetworkWarnUserIfOnlineAndCantSavestate() without the negation, so next-slot only works when online savestates are blocked.
VIRTKEY_NEXT_SLOT tests NetworkWarnUserIfOnlineAndCantSavestate() without the negation used everywhere else, so the next-slot hotkey only works when savestates are blocked and never in normal play.

fix_subject: Fix a pointer ARRAY_SIZE() compare (eek.)
defect: NativeKeyboard allocates input with new char[] and then uses ARRAY_SIZE(input) on the pointer (and sizeof(input) in memset), so the bound is the pointer size, not FieldMaxLength().

NativeKeyboard bounds the copy with ARRAY_SIZE(input) on a heap pointer (and memsets only sizeof(input) bytes), so the limit is sizeof(char*)/1 instead of the buffer length and the copied text is truncated or uses uninitialized bytes.

fix_subject: Fix issue with vertex shader IDs. Write the 4th component of packed vectors. The latter makes sure we leave no holes in the CPU writebuffer.
defect: The change only encodes the light types into the vertex shader ID when lighting is enabled, but shade mapping (UV gen mode 2) still uses the light types for LIGHT_DOTONLY lights, so different shaders collide on one ID.

The change only encodes light-type bits into the vertex shader ID when lighting is enabled, but the generator still uses ltype for shade-mapping lights (UV gen mode 2) with lighting off, so different shaders share one ID and the wrong cached shader is used.

fix_subject: Fixed divide by zero issue and tweaked the values just right for rhythm games
defect: Setting chanQueueMinSizeFactor to 0 makes __AudioEnqueue compute blockSamples = size / 2 / chanQueueMinSizeFactor, an integer division by zero.
Setting chanQueueMinSizeFactor to 0 makes __AudioEnqueue compute sampleQueue.size() / 2 / chanQueueMinSizeFactor, an integer divide by zero on every blocking audio output.

fix_subject: Fix breaking the button.. :|
defect: Narrowing the reset condition to fpsLimit != 0 makes EmuScreen::update force fpsLimit back to 0 every frame, breaking the button that toggles fpsLimit to 1.
The supposed dead-code removal changed the condition so any non-zero fpsLimit is reset to 0 every update, which breaks the alternate-speed (fpsLimit 1) button.

fix_subject: Fix left/right/up/down wrapping issues in OSK.
defect: The OSK navigation added here moves by 10 for up/down (rows are 12 keys wide, and up/down are reversed) and wraps at 44 instead of the 48 valid keys.
The new OSK cursor navigation moves UP/DOWN by 10 although rows hold 12 keys (and UP increases the index, moving down) and wraps at 44 instead of the 48 keys, so selection jumps to the wrong keys.

fix_subject: Fix InputBox in Qt
defect: The new System_MakeRequest returns bool but has no return statement after the switch, so control falls off the end of a non-void function (undefined behaviour).
The new System_MakeRequest body has no return statement on any path (the old stub returned false), so control falls off the end of a bool function, undefined behaviour.

fix_subject: Regression fix : Revert #3776
defect: The change reads back every framebuffer younger than FBO_OLD_AGE on every second frame, dropping the age == 0 and !memoryUpdated guards, so stale framebuffers are repeatedly copied over memory.
The new skiptwo condition reads every recently used framebuffer back to memory on every other frame, dropping the age == 0 and !memoryUpdated checks, which caused a regression in FBO-to-memory mode.

fix_subject: Fix vf2i properly on x86.
defect: round_vfpu_n takes a float but is called with the double sv, so the clamped 0x7fffffff becomes 2^31 (int overflow to 0x80000000) and large values lose precision before rounding.
The new round_vfpu_n takes a float, so the clamped double sv (up to 0x7fffffff) is rounded to float 2147483648.0f and the (int) conversion overflows, giving wrong vf2in results for large values.

fix_subject: Fix depal bounds with dynamic CLUT. Fixes lens flare glitches in Ridge Racer
defect: ApplyTextureDepal multiplies the vertex bounds by texWidth/texHeight although KnownVertexBounds are already pixel coordinates, so the depal scissor and blit rectangle are wrong.

ApplyTextureDepal multiplies gstate_c.vertBounds (already pixel coordinates) by texWidth/texHeight, so the depal blit/scissor rectangle is wrong and garbage from the DONT_CARE temp buffer gets sampled.

fix_subject: Fix linux compile
defect: sceMpegGetPcmAu checks the std::map find result with the MSVC-internal member streamInfo._Ptr, which does not compile with libstdc++ on Linux.
The new check uses the MSVC-internal iterator member streamInfo._Ptr instead of comparing with streamMap.end(), which does not compile with libstdc++/libc++ and is not a valid not-found test anyway.

fix_subject: Fix 4x4
defect: The non-SIMD Mul4x4By4x4 fallback indexes b.m[i*4+k] * a.m[k*4+j] for result.m[j*4+i], which yields a transposed product with column-major storage.
The new non-SIMD fallback Mul4x4By4x4 indexes b.m[i*4+k] * a.m[k*4+j] for column-major matrices, producing a transposed/wrong product.

fix_subject: Win32 UI: Remove secondary loop for unchecking/checking Window Zoom options. It was not needed, and caused a bug..
defect: UpdateMenus gains a second zoom loop comparing i == iWindowZoom (off by one) that overrides the correct i == iWindowZoom - 1 check, so the wrong zoom item is checked.
The added second zoom-menu loop compares the 0-based index with the 1-based iWindowZoom (i == iWindowZoom), overriding the correct earlier loop so the wrong zoom item is checked.

fix_subject: Fix emu screen trashing legacy input
defect: The legacy mapping loop now ORs input.pad_buttons_down & mapping[i][0] (PAD_BUTTON bits) into pressed instead of the PSP CTRL bit mapping[i][1], scrambling legacy input.
The rewritten legacy mapping ORs the PAD_BUTTON_* bit (mapping[i][0]) into the PSP button mask instead of the CTRL_* value (mapping[i][1]), so legacy pad input presses the wrong PSP buttons.

fix_subject: fixed compiling error
defect: listStatus was switched to DisplayListQueue::const_iterator with cbegin()/cend(), C++11 library members missing on a supported toolchain, causing a compile error.
The cleanup switched listStatus to dlQueue.cbegin()/cend() const_iterators, which the project's toolchains at the time did not provide, breaking the build.

fix_subject: Fix really stupid heap corruption mistake.
defect: rebalance now calls realloc with the old capacity and then doubles capacity, so the queue writes past the end of its buffer (heap corruption).
rebalance now reallocs the queue to the old capacity and then doubles cur->capacity, so the buffer is half the recorded size and later writes overflow the heap.

fix_subject: Fix time compares in save focus. Was breaking platforms (like QNX) where time is stored as a 64-bit unsigned value (nanoseconds).
defect: The new GetOldestSave starts idxTime at 0 and keeps entries with a smaller time, so it can only pick entries whose mktime is negative or -1, i.e. empty save slots, never the oldest real save.

The new GetOldestSave compares raw time_t values from mktime on every list entry, so empty slots (zeroed modif_time, negative or on QNX huge unsigned mktime result) win or break the comparison and the wrong save gets focus.

fix_subject: Fix flipped check for debug overlays
defect: The in-game check is inverted: DEBUG_STATS and FRAME_GRAPH are drawn only when not in game, the opposite of the commit's intent.
The new inGame check is inverted (if (!inGame)), so the debug stats and frame graph overlays draw only outside the game and never in-game.

fix_subject: Fix another silly mixup, sigh
defect: The #ifdef GOLD branches are swapped, so Gold builds are titled "PPSSPP" and normal builds "PPSSPP Gold".
The #ifdef GOLD branches are swapped, so Gold builds are titled "PPSSPP " and regular builds "PPSSPP Gold ".

fix_subject: Fix bounds check in sceKernelPrintf().
defect: The %08x bounds check uses i + 3 >= n, rejecting a format string that ends in %08x.
The %08x bounds check uses i + 3 >= n, an off-by-one that rejects a format string ending in %08x as unsupported.

fix_subject: Fix bug where the 'o' char input got eaten because the char matches the keycode for Esc..
defect: Dropping the KEY_DOWN check lets KEY_CHAR events through the key-mapping lookup, so a typed 'o' whose char code equals the Esc keycode maps to VIRTKEY_PAUSE (also added here) and is eaten.

Dropping the (key.flags & KEY_DOWN) condition lets KEY_CHAR events, whose keyCode holds a character, through the mapping lookup, so a char like 'o' that equals the Esc keycode is treated as the pause/debugger vkey and eaten.

fix_subject: Fix bug in GLES texture filter setup
defect: ApplySamplingParams builds a 3-bit mip key with the mag filter bit and uses it to index the 2-entry MagFiltGL array (out of bounds) while passing a plain linear/nearest as the min filter, swapping min and mag handling.

The new ApplySamplingParams swaps min and mag filters: it indexes the two-entry MagFiltGL with a 3-bit mip key (out-of-bounds read up to index 7) and passes a plain linear/nearest value as the min filter, losing mipmap filtering.

fix_subject: bugfix of LoadRelocations2
defect: LoadRelocations2 reads type_table_size from flag_table[0] instead of type_table[0], misparsing the relocation stream.
LoadRelocations2 reads type_table_size from flag_table[0] instead of type_table[0], so the type table is skipped by the wrong length and the relocation stream is parsed from the wrong offset.

For REPLACE_ALPHA_NO the change forces amask = false, but ReplaceAlphaWithStencil also returns NO in clear mode and for stencil-enabled alpha blending without dual-source, where the old code honoured pmska, so alpha writes are wrongly masked.

The new switch forces amask = false for REPLACE_ALPHA_NO, which ReplaceAlphaWithStencil also returns with stencil enabled but no dual-source blending, so alpha writes that previously followed pmska are suppressed.

fix_subject: Fix shadow abormal in FF Type-0
defect: Moving the cull setup into the non-clear branch leaves the previous draw's culling enabled during clear-mode draws, so clear primitives can be culled (FF Type-0 shadows).
Moving the cull setup into the non-clear branch means clear-mode draws never disable face culling, so a stale cull state from the previous draw can cull clear geometry.

fix_subject: Fix #6898 - buttons could disappear in non-buffered rendering
defect: Replacing UIShader_Prepare with a texture rebind and a blend state drops its reset of cull, depth test, scissor, stencil and color mask, so the overlay is drawn with the game's leftover GL state and buttons can vanish in non-buffered rendering.

Replacing UIShader_Prepare() by only RebindTexture plus a blend state dropped the resets of depth test, stencil test, culling and scissor, so in non-buffered rendering the game's leftover GL state applies to the overlay and the on-screen buttons can disappear.

fix_subject: Init parameters in __UsbMicInit to avoid incorrect initial state when you exit to menu from ingame.
defect: __UsbMicInit does not reset the module state (waitingThreads, isNeedInput, numNeedSamples, audio buffer), so after exiting a game to the menu the next game starts with stale waiters and flags.

The new globals (waitingThreads, isNeedInput, numNeedSamples, audioBufSize) are never reset by __UsbMicInit/__UsbMicShutdown, so after exiting to the menu and starting again stale waiting threads and flags survive (and audioBuf is freed while audioBufSize keeps its value).

fix_subject: Fix another stupid mistake.
defect: The change calls __IoCompleteAsyncIO in __IoSyncNotify for the host and default timing modes, consuming the IO manager result before the following WaitResult reads it for the synchronous call.

The added __IoCompleteAsyncIO(f) calls in __IoSyncNotify consume the ioManager result (and fire the async callback), so the following ioManager.WaitResult fails and the threaded synchronous read/write returns -1.

fix_subject: Fix typo which disabled GEDebugger
defect: Replacing #if defined(_M_ARM64) || defined(_M_ARM) with #if PPSSPP_API(ANY_GL) inverts the condition, so the GE debugger menu item is greyed out on every GL-capable build.
Rewriting '#if defined(_M_ARM64) || defined(_M_ARM)' as '#if PPSSPP_API(ANY_GL)' lost the negation, so the GE debugger menu item is grayed out on every GL build.

fix_subject: Fixed infrequent segfault in CheckAlpha
defect: The new stride-aware CheckAlpha loops for the 16-bit formats walk a u32 pointer but advance it by `stride` u32s per row although stride is in 16-bit pixels, so they skip every other row and read past the end of the buffer.
For 16-bit formats CheckAlpha walks a u32 pointer but advances it by stride (in pixels) per row, twice the row size, so it skips rows and reads past the buffer.

fix_subject: Don't crash when enable debug stats is enabled in a game, then turned off after exiting a game.
defect: GameSettingsScreen::update calls MIPSComp::jit->ClearCache() whenever the debug-stats toggle changes, even when no game is running, and the stale jit left after exiting a game then crashes.

update() calls MIPSComp::jit->ClearCache() when the debug-stats toggle changes, guarded only by a non-null jit pointer, which stays set after a game shuts down, so toggling it from the menu after exiting a game crashes.

fix_subject: Fix Apple gpu detection
defect: The vendor check was changed from "Apple" to "Apple Inc." instead of adding the new string, so drivers that report "Apple" are no longer detected as GPU_VENDOR_APPLE.
The vendor match was changed from 'Apple' to 'Apple Inc.' instead of adding the new string, so drivers that report 'Apple' are no longer detected as GPU_VENDOR_APPLE.

fix_subject: Fix a glitch in host timing in some games.
defect: With host IO timing, __IoAsyncNotify keeps rescheduling itself until ioManager.HasResult() is true, but async operations that never queue a manager operation never get a result, so the notification is postponed forever.

With host IO timing, __IoAsyncNotify reschedules itself until ioManager.HasResult, but async operations that never queue on the IO thread never produce a result, so their notification loops forever and the game hangs.

fix_subject: Fixes, state invalidation
defect: The ported BlitFramebuffer keeps unscaled coordinates (factor 1.0) when not using a hardware blit but now passes them to the new BlitUsingRaster, which normalises by the scaled framebuffer dimensions, so raster and copy fallbacks blit the wrong region at render scale above 1.

The new common BlitFramebuffer passes unscaled coordinates (factor 1.0) on the non-blit path, but the new BlitUsingRaster normalizes by the render-scaled FBO size, so at render scale above 1 the wrong region is blitted.

fix_subject: fix empty string checking
defect: DeleteData checks `param->fileName == NULL` on a fixed char array, which is never null, so an empty file name is not rejected and the save directory path is passed to RemoveFile.
DeleteData tests 'param->fileName == NULL' on a char array, which is never true, so an empty file name is not rejected and the deletion targets the save directory path.

fix_subject: softjit: Fix fog typo causing locking bug.
defect: The SSE4.1 branch of Jit_ApplyFog calls GetGState() a second time into a shadowing gstateReg, so the gstate register is locked twice but unlocked once.
The SSE4.1 branch of Jit_ApplyFog calls GetGState() again into a shadowing local, locking the gstate register twice but unlocking it once.

fix_subject: Fix linux build.
defect: CreateAVI passes the std::string discID through StringFromFormat's varargs for %s, which fails to compile on GCC/Clang and is undefined behaviour elsewhere.
A std::string (discID) is passed for %s to the variadic StringFromFormat, which is undefined behaviour and does not compile on GCC/Clang.

fix_subject: Achivement list rendering fix (wrong alpha)
defect: The new GameAchievementSummaryView::Draw calls RenderGameAchievementSummary with opacity 0.0f, so the summary background is drawn fully transparent.
The new GameAchievementSummaryView::Draw passes 0.0 as the opacity, so the summary is drawn with a fully transparent background (and, once alpha was applied to text, invisible text).

fix_subject: Save more of the GPU's state, fix a crash.
defect: ExecuteOp's default case now logs currentList->pc, but ExecuteOp is also called without an active display list (e.g. when reapplying GPU state) while currentList is null, which crashes.

ExecuteOp now dereferences currentList->pc (default-case log, ORIGIN, jumps) where it used the always-valid dcontext, but ReapplyGfxState calls ExecuteOp outside any list while currentList is NULL, crashing.

fix_subject: Fix missing ;
defect: The rewrite adds `using namespace KeyMap` without a terminating semicolon, so KeyMap.cpp does not compile.
'using namespace KeyMap' lacks its semicolon, so KeyMap.cpp does not compile.

fix_subject: Fix a wrong condition
defect: The pixel-size condition `fmt == GPU_DBG_FORMAT_8888 || GPU_DBG_FORMAT_8888_BGRA || ...` tests a nonzero constant and is always true, so every debug buffer is allocated with 4 bytes per pixel.
The condition 'fmt == GPU_DBG_FORMAT_8888 || GPU_DBG_FORMAT_8888_BGRA || ...' has a constant non-zero operand, so every format gets pixelSize 4.

fix_subject: Symbian: Fix incorrect define. Wasn't showing correct # cores.
defect: The new Symbian branch is guarded by `#elif defined(SYMBIAN)`, a macro that is never defined, so the Symbian CPU info is never set.
The new Symbian branch tests 'defined(SYMBIAN)' instead of '__SYMBIAN32__', so it never compiles in and the Symbian CPU info is not set.

fix_subject: Fix DXT5 alpha channel
defect: The new decodeDXT5Block fills the interpolated alpha table in reverse order (lerp8(src, 6) for index 2 down to lerp8(src, 1) for index 7, same for the 6-value mode), so DXT5 alpha values are wrong.
The new DXT5 decoder fills the interpolated alpha table in reverse order (alpha[2] = lerp8(src, 6) instead of lerp8(src, 1), etc.), so interpolated alpha values are wrong.

fix_subject: Fix crash on Symbian when doing "Return to Menu"
defect: On Symbian, ReleaseView decommits at offset view - Base() without masking with 0x3FFFFFFF, although the views were committed at virtual_address & 0x3FFFFFFF, so shutdown decommits the wrong range and crashes.
The new Symbian ReleaseView decommits at view - Base() without masking by 0x3FFFFFFF, while the views were committed at masked offsets, so Return to Menu decommits wrong ranges and crashes.

fix_subject: Fix volume scaling for mono inputs, etc.
defect: The added __AdjustBGMVolume calls scale numSamples * pFrame->channels samples, the input channel count, while swr_convert writes atracOutputChannels channels, so mono sources get only half the output scaled.

__AdjustBGMVolume is given numSamples * pFrame->channels (input channels) although swr_convert writes atracOutputChannels channels, so mono sources are only half scaled and stereo-to-mono output is overrun.

fix_subject: Fix typo (and maybe a bug).
defect: Refresh() calls rows_.empty() instead of rows_.clear(), so rows_ keeps pointers to views deleted by Clear() and later SetFocus() calls use freed views.
Refresh calls rows_.empty() instead of rows_.clear(), so rows_ keeps pointers to rows deleted by Clear() and later SetFocus on rows_[i] touches freed views.

fix_subject: fix GCC warning
defect: The added else branch frees a buffer allocated with new[] using free(), a mismatched deallocation (undefined behaviour).
The added else branch frees a buffer from new[] with free(), a mismatched deallocation.

fix_subject: Fix Start/Select button in OSK screen
defect: The physical button labels Start and Select are routed through the same translation keys as the actions, so translated languages show the verb (e.g. the 'Select' action text) as the Select button name.
The labels of the PSP Start and Select buttons are run through the Dialog translations, sharing the 'Select' key used for the Cross action, so translated builds show wrong button names.

fix_subject: Fix windows build
defect: The Windows branch declares 'mode = OPEN_EXISTING,' followed by 'const DWORD flags', a syntax error, and calls CloseHandle(_handle) on an undeclared name, breaking the Windows build.
The new Windows branch has a syntax error (',' followed by 'const DWORD'), uses '_handle' for 'handle_', and lacks the utf8 include for ConvertUTF8ToWString, so the Windows build fails.

fix_subject: Fix #8001, although I don't quite understand what was wrong...
defect: I18NCategory::name_ becomes a non-owning const char*, but LoadIni passes iter->name().c_str() of a local IniFile section, so the name dangles after loading.
I18NCategory now keeps name_ as a raw const char* without copying, but LoadIni creates categories with section names owned by a local IniFile, leaving dangling name pointers.

fix_subject: Fix hang when changing UMD with retroachievements enabled
defect: __UmdReplace now calls Achievements::ChangeUMD, whose implementation (changed in the same commit) sets g_isIdentifying=true after rc_client_begin_change_media, so a synchronous or failed callback leaves execution blocked and the game hangs.

This commit's Achievements::ChangeUMD sets g_isIdentifying = true after rc_client_begin_change_media, so when the callback runs synchronously the flag stays true and IsBlockingExecution stalls emulation after a UMD swap.

fix_subject: Fix lazy loading of metadata
defect: LoadAtlasMetadata, now called from UpdateTheme for the per-theme atlas, skips loading when metadata is already loaded, so switching themes keeps the old atlas metadata with the new atlas image.
The new LoadAtlasMetadata skips loading once metadata is loaded, so switching to a theme with another UIAtlas keeps the old metadata while the new .zim image is bound.

fix_subject: Fix challenge mode check, fixing savestates not showing up if logged out
defect: ChallengeModeActive now returns rc_client_get_hardcore_enabled, and the change removed the explicit hardcore disable in Initialize, so with no login (SetGame returns early) rc_client's default hardcore=on makes challenge mode active and hides savestates.

ChallengeModeActive now returns rc_client_get_hardcore_enabled and the explicit hardcore disable at init was removed; rc_client defaults to hardcore, so while logged out challenge mode reports active and savestates are hidden.

fix_subject: Fix crashes on Symbian related to memory allocation.
defect: The new Symbian bump allocator advances g_next_ptr (void* arithmetic) on every executable allocation and never rewinds, so re-creating the JIT runs past the 20 MB code chunk and crashes.

The Symbian executable allocator now Alloc()s the whole chunk size from a heap whose maximum equals it (the macro's trailing ';' discards '+ 3*GetPageSize()'), bumps a void* and never resets, so the allocation fails or overruns and the JIT crashes.

fix_subject: Fix ini-less texture replacement
defect: In the new state machine, PrepareData's 'already populated from cache' early return never sets ACTIVE, so the state stays PREPARED, the IsReady assert fails and ini-less replacements never become active.
In the new state machine the 'already populated from cache' early return of PrepareData never sets ACTIVE, so cached textures stay non-ACTIVE, CopyLevelTo refuses them and the post-wait assert fires.

fix_subject: Fix typo, ARM build.
defect: 'MIPSGPReg rd = _RD:' ends with a colon instead of a semicolon, breaking the ARM build.
'MIPSGPReg rd = _RD:' ends with a colon instead of a semicolon, breaking the ARM build.

fix_subject: Keep a reference to download objects for their lifetime. Should fix cancelling crashes.
defect: Download spawns a detached thread holding a raw 'this' while Downloader::Update (or the owner) can release the shared_ptr as soon as progress/failed is set, so the thread can use a destroyed object.
Download starts a detached thread bound to a raw 'this', while Downloader::Update erases the only shared_ptr once Failed/Progress is set, so the thread can run on a destroyed Download.

fix_subject: Fix missing title screens in Growlanser
defect: The new FBO size heuristic (min of viewport, scissor and region) and the disabled update of v->width/height produce wrongly sized framebuffers, losing Growlanser's title screens.

The new GuessDrawingSize heuristic (minimum of viewport, scissor and region) together with commenting out the v->width/height update gives some framebuffers the wrong size, losing Growlanser's title screens.

fix_subject: Fix Katamari
defect: The depth-swizzle hack applies to any depth texture with address bits 0x200000, regardless of framebuffer format, so 16-bit framebuffers (Katamari) get a widened and wrongly swizzled texture.
The 0x200000 depth-swizzle hack is applied to any depth texture with those address bits, not only to 8888 framebuffers, which breaks Katamari.

fix_subject: Fix off-by-one on fast matrix loads.
defect: The new fast view/projection matrix loads loop with 'if (++i > end) break', allowing one write past the matrix and consuming one command too many.
The new view and projection fast-load loops break on '++i > end', loading one entry too many: past the end of the matrix and consuming an extra command.

fix_subject: Fix divide by 0 bug
defect: num = iFrameSkip - 1 is zero when frameskip is 1, so 'numFrames % num' divides by zero.
num = iFrameSkip - 1 is 0 when frameskip is 1, and gpuStats.numFrames % num divides by zero.

fix_subject: Fix VSync on Windows. Should fix #10711
defect: Moving the GL context to a separate render thread leaves SwapInterval calling wglSwapIntervalEXT from the emulation thread, where no context is current, so VSync no longer works.
Moving GL context creation to a render thread left SwapInterval calling wglSwapIntervalEXT on the calling emu/UI thread, where no context is current, so VSync changes have no effect.

fix_subject: softgpu: Implement almost working polygon clipping and fix some bugs.
defect: The moved SubmitPrimitive loop steps with ++vtx instead of vtx += 3 (the original code used += 3), so every vertex starts a triangle and reads past the decoded vertices.
The moved SubmitPrimitive loop increments vtx by 1 instead of 3 while reading vertices vtx..vtx+2, drawing a triangle per vertex and reading past the decoded vertices.

fix_subject: Fix shader compilation error.
defect: 'lowp vec3 unlitColor = u_matambientalpha;' assigns a vec4 uniform to a vec3, a GLSL compile error.
The generated GLSL assigns the vec4 uniform u_matambientalpha to a lowp vec3, which fails shader compilation.

fix_subject: Fix copy-paste fail..
defect: The failure branches for pic0 and pic1 delete and null iconTexture instead of pic0Texture/pic1Texture (copy-paste error), leaking the failed texture and dropping a valid icon.

In the pic0 and pic1 LoadPNG failure branches the change deletes and nulls info->iconTexture instead of pic0Texture/pic1Texture (copy-paste), leaking the failed pic texture, leaving it in use, and destroying a valid icon.

fix_subject: Fix crash in sceKernelDeleteHeap
defect: sceKernelDeleteHeap calls kernelObjects.Destroy, which already deletes the object, and then 'delete heap' again, a double free.
sceKernelDeleteHeap calls kernelObjects.Destroy<FPL>(heap->uid), which already deletes the HeapInformation object, and then deletes heap again (double free).

fix_subject: Fix image format for screenshots with Qt UI
defect: The new TakeGameScreenshot adds a SCREENSHOT_RENDER path (used for savestate screenshots) that yields 8888 buffers, but the Qt branch still wraps every buffer as QImage::Format_RGB888, so Qt savestate screenshots come out garbled.
The new SCREENSHOT_RENDER path (savestate thumbnails) yields 32-bit 8888 framebuffers, but the Qt branch still wraps every buffer as QImage::Format_RGB888, producing garbled Qt screenshots.

fix_subject: Fix OpenGL exit hang on Windows
defect: The main loop now calls graphicsContext->ThreadFrame(true), which blocks waiting for render tasks, and the emu thread no longer calls StopThread, so when the emu thread stops producing frames on exit the main thread hangs.

The main loop now calls the blocking ThreadFrame(true) until the state is DISABLED and the StopThread call in EmuThreadFunc was removed, so once the emu thread quits the main thread waits forever (OpenGL exit hang).

fix_subject: Fix a string pointer comparison.
defect: entry.fileName == 'jpn0.pgf' compares a const char* against a string literal by pointer, so the provided-font detection is unreliable.
entry.fileName is a const char*, so 'entry.fileName == "jpn0.pgf"' compares pointers rather than strings and the jpn0 metrics hack only works by chance of literal pooling.

fix_subject: Fix silly typo breaking alpha test in many cases. Make some log VERBOSE.
defect: enableAlphaTest is computed from gstate.alphaBlendEnable instead of gstate.alphaTestEnable in both ComputeFragmentShaderID and GenerateFragmentShader, breaking the alpha test.

enableAlphaTest is computed from gstate.alphaBlendEnable instead of alphaTestEnable in both ComputeFragmentShaderID and GenerateFragmentShader, so alpha test is dropped or applied depending on blending.

fix_subject: Fix the AxisSwap feature - had a double mutex lock, oops.
defect: ToggleSwapAxes now takes std::lock_guard on mutex_, but it is invoked from an onVKey handler that already holds mutex_, so the non-recursive mutex is locked twice (deadlock/UB).

ToggleSwapAxes now takes lock_guard on mutex_, but it is called from the onVKey_ handler (EmuScreen, VIRTKEY_AXIS_SWAP) while UpdatePSPState already holds mutex_, so the non-recursive mutex is locked twice (deadlock).

fix_subject: Fix regression caused by the new depal code for Vulkan. Fixes #10993
defect: The new Vulkan shader-depal path sets gstate_c.useShaderDepal without dirtying the fragment shader state, never resets it on the non-depal framebuffer paths, and uses shader depal even when texturing from the current render target.

The new shader-depal path is always taken (even when sampling the current render target) and gstate_c.useShaderDepal / the depal texture are not reset in the other framebuffer paths, so stale shader-depal state breaks later draws (#10993).

fix_subject: Fix a few warnings, mostly type comparisons.
defect: The ERROR_LOG_REPORT_ONCE call passes the char array 'offset' for a %i specifier, so it logs garbage instead of the CLUT offset (undefined behaviour).
The added ERROR_LOG_REPORT_ONCE passes the char array offset for a %i conversion (format/argument mismatch, undefined behaviour and a garbage log value).

fix_subject: Fix a bunch of edge cases
defect: The new condition 'gpu && !gpu->PresentedThisFrame()' clears the backbuffer every frame in skip-buffer-effects (non-buffered) mode, where the game draws directly to the backbuffer without CopyToOutput, wiping the frame.

The new condition clears the backbuffer whenever gpu->PresentedThisFrame() is false, which is always the case with skip-buffer-effects (non-buffered) rendering, wiping the frame the game drew directly to the backbuffer; viewport/scissor are also left unset.

fix_subject: Fix oversight that could cause crashes with shader blending in GL
defect: The renamed call BindFramebufferAsColorTexture(1, nullptr, ...) still passes nullptr, but the same commit removed the null-to-currentRenderVfb_ fallback, so shader blending dereferences a null framebuffer and crashes.

The call was switched to BindFramebufferAsColorTexture(1, nullptr, ...), but the renamed function no longer maps a null framebuffer to currentRenderVfb_, so shader blending dereferences null and crashes.

fix_subject: Fix minor theme issue in Store, thanks Nabn00b.
defect: Replacing the hardcoded 0xFFbd9939 title bar with theme colors picked itemFocusedStyle, which changes the store title's look, while the original color matches itemDownStyle.

The store title bar now uses itemFocusedStyle colours, which differ from the previously hardcoded 0xFFbd9939 (the theme's itemDownStyle), so the title bar looks like a focused item and has wrong theme colours.

fix_subject: Fix some formatting warnings.
defect: The new AllocMemoryBlock failure log has %s, %i, %08x, %08x specifiers but no arguments, so printf reads garbage (the %s can crash) when allocation fails.
The new ERROR_LOG in AllocMemoryBlock has four format specifiers (%s, %i, %08x, %08x) but no arguments, reading garbage varargs (undefined behaviour, possible crash on %s).

fix_subject: Fix someting wrong.
defect: convertYCbCrToABGR packs red at bit 16 and blue at bit 0 (ARGB), so sceJpegCsc writes images with red and blue swapped.
convertYCbCrToABGR packs red at bit 16 and blue at bit 0 (ARGB) although the PSP output is ABGR, so sceJpegCsc swaps red and blue.

fix_subject: Fix language selection and a couple of untranslatable strings
defect: Renaming the label to 'Force <=60 FPS (helps GoW)' puts '=' in the i18n key, which cannot be expressed in the key=value language ini files, so the string becomes untranslatable.
The label key was changed to 'Force <=60 FPS (helps GoW)', whose '=' breaks the key=value i18n ini format, so the string cannot be translated.

fix_subject: Fix language selection and a couple of untranslatable strings
defect: NewLanguageScreen skips README entries when building the visible list but keeps them in langs_, and OnCompleted indexes langs_ with the list selection, so the wrong language is applied.

The constructor skips README entries when building the display list but keeps them in langs_, and OnCompleted indexes langs_ with the list selection, so the selected language can map to the wrong file.

fix_subject: Fix CPUDetect for i386 devices. Thanks @Sonic1. Confirmed by ganoo.
defect: The new __cpuidex inline asm saves and restores ebx with push/pop on i386 without declaring ebx clobbered while writing outputs through memory operands, so on i386 the compiler may address those operands through ebx or esp and the CPUID results are corrupted.

The new non-Windows __cpuidex saves ebx with push/pop on i386 instead of declaring it clobbered, so the compiler may address outputs through ebx (or a shifted esp) and cpuid corrupts the writes on i386.

fix_subject: Fix crash bug when cleaning duplicates of recent files
defect: AddRecent now continues the loop after recentIsos.erase(str) and then increments the invalidated iterator, which is undefined behaviour and crashes when a duplicate is found.
AddRecent now erases from recentIsos inside the iterator loop and keeps incrementing the invalidated iterator (the old code returned right after the erase), which is undefined behaviour and crashes.

fix_subject: D3D11: Can now switch post shader at runtime, and won't crash if they fail to translate correctly.
defect: CompileShaderToBytecode calls Crash() whenever a shader fails to compile, so a failed (for example translated post) shader kills the emulator instead of returning an empty result.
CompileShaderToBytecode now calls Crash() whenever shader compilation fails, although callers handle an empty result, so a post shader that fails to translate crashes the app.
