fix_subject: Don't try to go out of bounds. Still crashes without the Framebuffer.cpp edit, though..
defect: The shader menu handler checks only 'index >= 0' on an unsigned index (always true) before indexing availableShaders, so any unhandled menu ID reads out of bounds.
index is u32, so 'index >= 0' is always true and any unhandled menu command indexes availableShaders out of bounds.

fix_subject: samplerjit: Avoid gather if overread could crash.
defect: Jit_ReadQuad uses VPGATHERDD to load a full 32-bit dword at each CLUT4 texel's byte offset, so a texture placed at the very end of VRAM is overread and can segfault.
The new VPGATHERDD loads read 32 bits at texel byte offsets, which can read past the end of a CLUT4 texture placed at the end of VRAM and segfault.

fix_subject: Fix color test.
defect: The rewritten bitwise color test computes colorTestRef as roundAndScaleTo8x4(u_alphacolorref.rgb), multiplying an already 0..255 reference by 255 again, so the comparison against the masked fragment color is wrong.
The new bitwise colour test applies roundAndScaleTo8x4 (scale by 255) to u_alphacolorref.rgb, which already holds 0-255 values, so the reference is wrong and the colour test fails.

fix_subject: Fix line rendering in texmode
defect: The new SnapGrid::Draw draws its lines with vLine/hLine while the UI context is in textured mode, so the grid lines render incorrectly (and the grid is added on top of the controls).
SnapGrid::Draw draws vLine/hLine while the UI context is in textured mode, so the grid lines render incorrectly (and the grid is added on top of the controls).

fix_subject: Fix speed percentage calculation
defect: The combined FPS/speed display divides vps by the integer iDisplayRefreshRate (60) instead of the PSP's 59.94 Hz, so full speed shows as about 99.9%.
The speed percentage now divides by g_Config.iDisplayRefreshRate (integer, default 60) instead of 59.94, so full speed shows about 99.9 percent.

fix_subject: Fix some compiler warnings
defect: The new matchingSize expression is mis-parenthesized, so the height check binds only to the 480/512 case and depth is blitted between buffers of equal width but different height.
The new matchingSize expression has wrong precedence, so the height comparison applies only to the 480/512 case and equal-width buffers of different heights get a depth blit.

fix_subject: riscv: Fix crash on clear icache.
defect: For a full icache clear, InvalidateCacheAt skips InvalidateBlock on each block and calls ClearAllBlocks instead, so blocks are not marked invalid and the RISC-V JIT crashes when execution returns into a cleared block.
On a full icache clear InvalidateCacheAt skips InvalidateBlock and calls backend_->ClearAllBlocks(), wiping native code that may still be executing (the clear comes from a syscall), which crashes.

fix_subject: Fix more buggy string arithmetic in LogManager
defect: After halving msg to MAX_MSGLEN, the new code advances msgPos by vsnprintf's would-be length and then writes '\n' and '\0' at msgPos, so any truncated long message writes past the end of the stack buffer.
The rewritten code halves msg to MAX_MSGLEN but still advances msgPos by vsnprintf's would-be length, so any truncated message writes the newline and terminator past the buffer.

fix_subject: Fix dumb typo involving slash replacements.
defect: The new Windows path normalization calls ReplaceAll(e.s, "//", "/") instead of replacing backslashes, so paths keep their backslashes and duplicate recents are not eliminated.
The change meant to replace backslashes with forward slashes but calls ReplaceAll(e.s, "//", "/"), so Windows paths keep their backslashes and recents still get duplicates.

fix_subject: Fix coloring of sliders when dragging
defect: The new themable Slider::Draw picks the 'pressed' colour from down_, which Clickable clears whenever the finger leaves the bounds mid-drag, so the slider's line, knob and value revert to the normal colour while it is still being dragged.

The new slider colour selection keys the dragging colour on down_, which Clickable clears when the pointer leaves the bounds while dragging_ stays true, so the slider colour flips while dragging (#20617).

fix_subject: Fix some warnings in shader cache read.
defect: LoadAndPrecompile ignores fread's result for the shader IDs, so a truncated cache compiles shaders from uninitialized IDs, and it uses vsCache_[vsid]/fsCache_[fsid], which insert null entries for unknown IDs that are then dereferenced via vs->UseHWTransform().

LoadAndPrecompile ignores fread results and looks up vsCache_[vsid]/fsCache_[fsid] with operator[], so a truncated or inconsistent cache file gives uninitialised IDs and null shaders dereferenced in vs->UseHWTransform().

fix_subject: Fix copy/paste mistake.
defect: The new trigCallHelper lambda passes &sinCosFunc (the address of its local function-pointer parameter) instead of sinCosFunc, so the JIT emits a call into the stack rather than to SinOnly/CosOnly/ASinScaled/NegSinOnly.
trigCallHelper passes &sinCosFunc, the address of the local parameter, instead of the function pointer, so the JIT calls into the stack and crashes.

fix_subject: Fix wrong thread id when resuming after interrupt.
defect: The new __KernelSwitchToThread calls __KernelChangeReadyState(current, threadID, true) with the target thread's id instead of the current (idle) thread's id, corrupting the ready queue.

The new __KernelSwitchToThread calls __KernelChangeReadyState(current, threadID, true) with the target thread's id instead of the current thread's id (copied from __KernelSwitchOffThread, where threadID meant currentThread), corrupting the ready queues.

fix_subject: Fix translation mistake
defect: The new NiceTimeFormat fetches the DIALOG translation category into di but never uses it, so the seconds, minutes and hours strings are always shown untranslated.
NiceTimeFormat fetches the Dialog i18n category but formats with the literal English strings, so the time shown in the new exit-confirmation dialog is never translated.

fix_subject: Fix integer overflow in exponent decrease.
defect: The new exponent-decrease step computes (rate_ + 3) / 4 with rate_ an int, which overflows (undefined behaviour, negative result) for rates near 0x7FFFFFFF.

In the new exponent-decrease step, (rate_ + 3) / 4 is computed in signed int, so a rate near 0x7FFFFFFF overflows (undefined behaviour, in practice a negative value that makes the envelope rise instead of fall).

fix_subject: Fixed invalid preprocessor directive
defect: The added '#ifdef __ANDROID__ && __ANDROID_API__ < 21' is an ill-formed directive: the extra tokens are ignored, so every Android build takes the 32-bit stat path regardless of API level.

'#ifdef __ANDROID__ && __ANDROID_API__ < 21' is an invalid directive: #ifdef tests only __ANDROID__ and ignores the extra tokens, so every Android build, not only API < 21, uses 32-bit stat instead of stat64.

fix_subject: Fix window title. Also constify some keys.
defect: The window title prefix was changed from 'PPSSPP v0.6 - ' to PPSSPP_VERSION_STR ' - ', which drops the product name because the macro expands to just '0.6.1'.
The window title was changed from "PPSSPP v0.6 - " to PPSSPP_VERSION_STR " - ", and since PPSSPP_VERSION_STR is just "0.6.1" the program name disappears from the title.

fix_subject: Replacement: Break the mip loading loop if a level is wrong. Also shrink the log output.
defect: When a mip level fails the new size check, the loop continues and later levels are pushed into levels_, so they land at the wrong level index.
When a mip level has the wrong size it is skipped but the loop continues, so a later correctly sized level is pushed into levels_ at the wrong index and is used as the wrong mip level.

fix_subject: Fix Mac build
defect: The SDL main now passes a DummyGraphicsContext to NativeInitGraphics, but DummyGraphicsContext::CreateThin3DContext returns nullptr, so thin3d is null at startup.
The SDL main passes a plain DummyGraphicsContext to NativeInitGraphics, whose CreateThin3DContext returns nullptr, so thin3d is null on SDL (Linux/Mac) builds.

fix_subject: Fix VLD1/VST1 n=4.
defect: The new RegCountToType returns type 4 for a four-register VLD1/VST1, but the ARM encoding for four registers is 0b0010, so n=4 loads and stores are mis-encoded.
The new RegCountToType returns type 4 for a four-register VLD1/VST1, but the ARM encoding for four registers is 0b0010, so VLD1/VST1 with n=4 emit the wrong instruction.

fix_subject: Fix wrong translation category
defect: The new Savedata Manager button looks up its label in the Networking translation category (n) instead of a Savedata category, so it is not translated correctly.
The new 'Savedata Manager' choice is looked up in the Networking i18n category (n->T) instead of the Savedata category, so its translation is not found.

fix_subject: Fix #12023, accidental disabling of the GL backend on non-Windows ARM platform caused by #12013.
defect: The added '#if !defined(_M_ARM64) && !defined(_M_ARM)' guards also disable the GLES backend on non-Windows ARM platforms such as Android, where _M_ARM is defined.
The guard '#if !defined(_M_ARM64) && !defined(_M_ARM)' meant to disable GLES on Windows ARM also disables it on 32-bit ARM Linux/Android, because Core/MemMap.h defines _M_ARM there.

fix_subject: Fix hang on stop before run w/ multithreading.
defect: The new SyncThread condition (eventsRunning_ || !eventsHaveRun_) keeps waiting forever when the event thread never started, for example on a forced stop before run.
The new SyncThread wait condition '(eventsRunning_ || !eventsHaveRun_)' keeps waiting forever when the GPU thread has never run, so SyncThread(true) on stop before run hangs.

fix_subject: Oops, fix typo causing clamping to clamp wrong.
defect: The new depth-range clamping does 'far += overageFar' instead of 'far -= overageFar', so far is pushed further out of range and zScale and zOffset are wrong.
The new depth clamping does 'far += overageFar' instead of 'far -= overageFar', so it pushes the far value further out instead of clamping it into [0, 1].

fix_subject: Fix unicode letters in PPSSPP folder
defect: The new OnSavePathOther branch writes installed.txt with ofstream::open on a narrow UTF-8 path, which fails on Windows when the PPSSPP folder contains non-ANSI characters.
OnSavePathOther writes installed.txt through a narrow std::ofstream::open on the UTF-8 exe path, which fails on Windows when the PPSSPP folder contains non-ASCII letters.

fix_subject: Fix a segfault in ReadAllWithProgress
defect: The new wait loop runs when progress is null (!progress is true) and then dereferences progress->cancelled, and it never checks whether cancelled itself is null, so it segfaults.

The rewritten wait loop is entered when progress is null (via the !progress branch) and then dereferences progress->cancelled, and it also dereferences the bool pointer progress->cancelled without checking it, although RequestProgress defaults cancelled to nullptr, so ReadAllWithProgress segfaults.

fix_subject: Fix completely wrong thread status switching.
defect: Scheduling now relies on threadReadyQueue, but the added ReSchedule code marks the running thread ready before the interrupt/callback early returns, and the queue is maintained wrongly in __KernelSwitchContext, so the thread state goes inconsistent.

Thread selection now takes the head of threadReadyQueue, but the queue bookkeeping is wrong: __KernelReSchedule marks the running thread READY (and queues it) even on the early-return interrupt/callback paths, and __KernelSwitchContext's inverted updates leave the switched-to thread in the queue with status READY instead of RUNNING.

fix_subject: Fix a typo
defect: The change relabels the Savestate Slot submenu accelerator from F3 to F2, which duplicates the Quick Save F2 label on the next line and shows the wrong shortcut.
The Savestate Slot submenu accelerator label was changed from F3 to F2, so the menu shows the quick-save key for next slot while the same commit's key map binds next slot to F3.

fix_subject: Fix bug in vertex shader generator. See #14260.
defect: The new StringFromFormat call for GE_PROJMAP_NORMALIZED_NORMAL has two %s but passes one argument, which is undefined behaviour and can corrupt the generated shader.

The new StringFromFormat for GE_PROJMAP_NORMALIZED_NORMAL has two %s conversions but only one argument, so the second %s reads a missing vararg (undefined behaviour, garbage or crash in the generated shader).

fix_subject: npdrmLseek/npdrmRead BUG fix
defect: The added SeekFile in npdrmLseek moves the file to data_offset+newPos, which is not block-aligned, and passes the caller's whence with an absolute position, so npdrmRead's next whole-block read decrypts misaligned data.

The added SeekFile in npdrmLseek moves the underlying handle to data_offset+newPos, which is not block aligned (and is passed with the caller's relative whence), while npdrmRead decrypts whole blocks read from the handle's current position, so reads after a seek (even a tell-style or same-block seek that used to work) decrypt misaligned data.

fix_subject: softgpu: Possibly fix a bug. Or make things worse. I don't know :/
defect: Callers pass row_pitch_bits as texbufwidth*8, treating the texel buffer width as bytes, so every non-8-bit texture format gets the wrong row and block stride.

SampleNearest passes texbufwidth*8 as row_pitch_bits, but texbufwidth counts texels, so the row pitch is wrong for every non-8-bit format (16-bit, 32-bit and CLUT4 textures sample the wrong rows, also in the swizzled path).

fix_subject: Fixes
defect: The new locals mouseDeltaX and mouseDeltaY are declared without initialization and are read in the mouse-axis code before any motion event sets them.

The mouse deltas were moved from zero-initialized statics to uninitialized locals mouseDeltaX and mouseDeltaY, which the per-frame mouse-control block reads and scales before any SDL_MOUSEMOTION event sets them (undefined behaviour, spurious axis input).

fix_subject: Fix portrait mode integer scaling
defect: Integer scaling always snaps outW to multiples of 480, which is wrong in portrait orientation, where the displayed width is 272.
The new integer-scale code always rounds the output width to multiples of 480, but in rotated (portrait) mode the displayed width is 272 pixels, so portrait output is not an integer scale.

fix_subject: Fix critical bug with GetSysDirectories.
defect: The rewrite tests writability on the exe directory (path) but deletes the test file from memstickpath, so the memstick folder is never checked and a stray test file is left behind; it also swaps the wide GetModuleFileName path for the ANSI GetExeDirectory.

The rewrite tests writability of the exe directory instead of memstickpath, so a custom installed.txt path is replaced by Documents whenever the exe directory is read-only and the test file left in the exe directory is never deleted, and it builds the paths from File::GetExeDirectory, which returns an ANSI rather than UTF-8 path.

fix_subject: Fix some minor warnings.
defect: GetCharInfo calls memset(charInfo, 0, sizeof(charInfo)), clearing only pointer-size bytes, so the rest of PGFCharInfo (e.g. pad) is left uninitialized.
GetCharInfo calls memset(charInfo, 0, sizeof(charInfo)) on a pointer, so only pointer-size bytes are zeroed and the struct (e.g. its pad bytes) is not cleared as intended.

fix_subject: Fix Refresh interval translation string
defect: The slider uses the translation key 'Refresh Interval' while the same commit renamed the lang ini keys to 'Refresh interval', so the label is never translated.
The slider label uses the translation key "Refresh Interval" while the same commit renamed the ini key to "Refresh interval", so the lookup misses and the label is never translated.
